articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband 3D Indoor Positioning with Wired Clock Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To solve the problem of static and dynamic errors of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) target positioning in 3D indoor ultra-wideband positioning (UWB) process, a wired clock synchronization 3D indoor positioning measurement method based on adaptive Kalman filter was proposed. NLOS error model based on arrival time localization principle and base station wired clock synchronization technology are used to build three-dimensional base station spatial layout and system architecture. In the process of adaptive Kalman filter, the gain matrix is modified by adaptive factor to reduce the positioning error in three dimensional space. Authority testing shows that in the indoor industrial environment, the horizontal positioning accuracy of UWB 3D positioning algorithm is better than 100 mm, and the elevation positioning accuracy is less than 200 mm, and low drift and high stability, which further improves the positioning accuracy of workshop mobile operations.

articleTitle: Development of Fiber Grating Crack Gauge Based on New Temperature Compensation Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to monitor the relative displacement of the building structure and the opening and closing degree of the cracks for a long time, a fiber grating crack gauge with a new temperature compensation structure is designed. The sensitive part of the built-in temperature compensated fiber grating sensor uses double gratings for temperature compensation. The “s” type elastic structure is adopted, which can reduce the structural stiffness to achieve a reasonable strain output. And the low elastic modulus temperature coefficient material is used, which can reduce the impact of small temperature change on the measured value fluctuation. The full-scale strain response test and high and low temperature temperature measurement test were carried out on the built-in temperature-compensated fiber grating sensor, the experimental results show that the built-in temperature compensated fiber grating crack gauge has high sensitivity, good linear output response and high temperature stability.

articleTitle: Design of IoT-Based Aquaculture Water Quality Parameter Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Traditional water quality monitoring in aquaculture in China is mainly done manually, which is not only time-consuming and labor-intensive, but also has low accuracy and is gradually being phased out by the market. To address the above-mentioned issues, the author has developed an aquaculture water quality parameter monitoring system using the Internet of Things. The system mainly consists of sensor modules, A/D conversion circuits, microcontrollers, and display terminals. Sensors such as pH value, conductivity, temperature, and dissolved oxygen are arranged at underwater nodes. Each sensor has a built-in conditioning circuit, which can convert the real-time collected parameter values into digital quantities through the A/D module. The network layout of the main station sensor and the sub-station using the STM32F103 microcontroller is constructed. The main station uses a master-slave mode to poll the sub-stations for data, and the data is collected and aggregated to mobile apps or remote computers and other monitoring terminals for processing and display through the 4G DTU wireless module. Research shows that the system has the characteristics of wide coverage, high real-time performance, remote monitoring and alarm, and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Support for MIMO Pre-Equalization in BI-DAC System: An Accurate Frequency Response Obtaining Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Software Defined Radio (SDR) is widely used in the military, civil aviation and other fields. SDR generates signal bandwidth with limited by Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) sampling rate, single DAC performance can hardly satisfy the bandwidth requirement of SDR systems, so multi-DAC parallel technology is proposed. Bandwidth Interleaving DAC (BI-DAC) is a frequency-based multi-DAC parallel technique, which splits the signal by frequency in the digital domain and then restores it in the analog domain, the aliasing error is one of the main errors in BI-DAC system. The aliasing error can be corrected by the Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) pre-equalization technique, while the accurate obtaining of the system frequency response matrix is the prerequisite for MIMO pre-equalization. In this paper, we propose a vector estimation method based on amplitude spectral scalar, which can accurately obtain the frequency response of the system. In addition, we verify the effectiveness of the method in this paper through an experiment, the result shows that the accuracy of the system frequency response obtained by this method meets the requirements of the MIMO pre-equalization technique.

articleTitle: Design of 1kW RF Power Amplifier for 230 MHz Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the goal of the national electric power system devoted to the construction of special wireless network, a kilowatt-level RF power amplifier applied to the electric power LTE230 wireless broadband communication network is realized. Based on the power synthesis technique, this paper uses self-developed RF-LDMOS devices, and chooses 3dB hybrid couplers with a phase difference of 90° at the ports. The two transistors are connected in parallel for 4-way synthesis. Meanwhile, the hybrid matchmaking method of capacitor and microstrip line is used instead of coaxial line matching, and finally achieves a power amplifier with balanced structure. The test results show that at the frequency of 230 MHz, the output power is 60.1dBm (1023W), the drain efficiency is 60.3%, the power gain is 19.8dB, and the module has good input and output standing-wave properties. This balanced power amplifier has achieved high degree of localization from the chip process to the module design. Moreover, it has a grate application value.

articleTitle: Method for Constructing Fault Knowledge Graph for PHM of Aircraft Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In response to the current problems in the maintenance process of aircraft power systems, such as relying on traditional experience, poor troubleshooting robustness, and slow response of maintenance personnel to fault changes. In this paper, Knowledge graph is introduced into the field of aviation power supply health management, and troubleshooting experience is presented in the form of Knowledge graph to improve the correlation ability between fault data. This paper proposes a method to build a fault Knowledge graph for aircraft power system health management based on the data source of a certain aircraft power system manual and typical fault cases: first, build a power system data set according to the semi structural and unstructured data such as the aircraft power system manual and typical fault cases; Then, the Bert-BiLSTM-Ptr-Net deep learning algorithm was applied to extract power system fault entities from power system manuals and typical fault cases, and the superiority of this algorithm was verified by comparing it with the Bert-BiLSTM-CRF algorithm; Next, the BERT-BiLSTM deep learning algorithm is used to extract relationships between power system fault entities. Compared to other deep learning algorithms, this algorithm has a relationship extraction effect in aircraft power system manuals and typical fault case texts; Finally, Neo4j Graph database is used to visualize the fault Knowledge graph of aircraft power system, which effectively improves the troubleshooting ability of maintenance personnel and is convenient to guide the fault maintenance of aircraft power system.

articleTitle: Measurement of Mass Attenuation Coefficients Based on Monochromatic X-Ray Radiation Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The mass attenuation coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$({\mu/\rho})$</tex> of materials plays an important role as a basic parameter in various fields involving ionizing radiation. Monochromatic X-ray sources with adjustable energy and X-ray detectors with excellent performance have great advantages in accurately measuring the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mu/\rho}$</tex> of material. Experimental measurements of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mu/\rho \mathrm{s}}$</tex> of Zr, Ag, and Cd metallic materials in the X-ray energy region of 10 keV-40<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{keV}$</tex> were performed using a monochromatic X-ray radiation device, and simulated values at the same energies were obtained using Monte Carlo simulations, and both were compared with the NIST database for analysis. The results show that the experimental values of Zr, Ag and Cd based on the monochromatic X-ray are in good agreement with the Monte Carlo simulation values. Both of them are consistent with NIST <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mu/\rho}$</tex> curve.

articleTitle: Novel Intelligent Calibration System for Automobile Engine Speed Measurement Based on Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In view of the problems of low efficiency and easy operation error of traditional manual calibration, a novel intelligent calibration system for automobile engine speed measuring instruments is developed based on machine vision and LabVIEW. The expected technical indicators and operating mechanism of the developed calibration system are proposed. On this basis, the construction of system hardware and software is specifically designed and realized. In particular, a visual recognition algorithm is designed to obtain the display value of the tested instrument in real time. The test results show that this system supports the calibration of various types of engine speed measuring instruments. It can realize automatic measurement within the calibration speed range of (500∼6000) r/min, and the calibration time can be shortened by nearly 70%.

articleTitle: The Adaptive Threshold-Based FFT Spectrum Stripe Edge Detection Method Used for Measuring The High-Frequency Vibration Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: On account of its characteristics of non-contact, simplicity, portability, and high accuracy, machine vision has gradually become one of the most flexible and effective methods for measuring vibration parameters. When using machine vision for high-frequency vibration measurement, the captured images inevitably suffer from blurring. To ensure the effectiveness of traditional high-frequency vibration measurement methods based on clear sequential images, image restoration techniques are required to deblurring the blurred images. However, this method has drawbacks such as complex algorithms and low measurement efficiency. This study propose a method for high-frequency vibration parameter measurement using FFT spectrum stripe edge detection on a single blurred image. By combining an improved Canny edge detection algorithm with the Radon transform, we achieve high-precision extraction of the direction and position of stripes in the FFT spectrum of the blurred image, enabling further calculation of the vibration direction and amplitude. The proposed method is evaluated using simulated high-frequency vibration-blurred images with a frequency of 600 Hz. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves accurate measurement of high-frequency vibration parameters. In low-amplitude scenarios, the measurement results outperform existing research methods and exhibit good stability.

articleTitle: BI-DAC System with Guard Band: Trade-off between Bandwidth and Aliasing Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: BI-DAC(Bandwidth Interleaving DAC) has shown great application potential in breaking through DAC bandwidth restriction. Aliasing error is one of the main errors in BI-DAC. This kind of error can be effectively eliminated by setting guard band. Considering the attenuation of filter transition band, there is a trade-off between the width of guard band and the suppression of aliasing. In this paper, the relationship between guard band and the transition band of analog filter is analyzed, and the expression of the relationship under the given aliasing suppression is proposed. Simulation results show that 50dB aliasing suppression can be achieved at the cost of 31 % bandwidth improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the Monochromatic Soft X-Rays Radiation Facility Using CCD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the twenty-first century, countries are competing to research and launch various astronomical satellites to explore the mysteries of the universe. In order to realize the inversion from observed data to real astronomical phenomena, there is an urgent need for ground calibration of X-rays on board detectors of various astronomical satellites in China. We have built a monochromatic soft X-rays radiation facility based on grating diffraction, which includes a windowless and multitarget X-rays machine, a non-harmonic grating monochromator, a soft X-rays detector and a vacuum cavity. The soft X-rays detector used here is a CCD. The different performances of the facility were researched and analyzed using CCD. The experimental results show that the facility has a spot size of 168.22 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a maximum count rate of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.01^{\ast} 10^{7}$</tex> cps when the energy is 584.47 eV. This research result can provide data support for subsequent detector calibration.

articleTitle: The Positive Pressure pVTt Gas Flow Standard Device Using Natural Gas as the Medium
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As a primary standard device, the pVTt method gas flow standard device is widely used and has been used as the main gas flow standard in many countries. Chongqing Branch of National Oil and Gas Large Flow Metering Station has established a set of pVTt gas flow standard device with working pressure of (0.1~1.2) MPa, flow range of (14~850) kg/h, Measurement uncertainty of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U_{\mathrm{r}}=0.07\%$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k=2$</tex>. The device uses a 2m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> tank as the standard container and uses 1.2 MPa natural gas stored in two 3300m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> spherical tanks upstream as the calibration gas. The advantage of this device is that it can operate under positive pressure using natural gas as the medium, and the upstream natural gas source pressure is relatively stable and the gas quality is clean, without the need for additional stabilizing and purifying devices. This device can perform calibration of critical flow Venturi nozzles, mass flow meters, and other gas flow meters with an accuracy level of 0.2 or below under positive pressure using natural gas as the medium. Using this detection standard device, a critical flow sonic nozzle with a throat diameter of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{d}=4.770\text{mm}$</tex> was calibrated and the uncertainty of the measurement results was analyzed, resulting in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U_{\mathrm{r}}=0.16\%$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k=2$</tex>.

articleTitle: Robot Mechanical Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: An image input ResNet-based (IIRB) method for wheeled robot mechanical fault diagnosis (MFD) is proposed. Firstly, the time series signal (TSS) of the vibration sensor is normalized, then converted into a two-dimensional (2D) line graph, and finally the 2D image is used as the input of the neural network. Secondly, a neural network is trained using image data. Finally, the trained neural network model is used to classify and identify the MFD of the wheeled robot. The gyroscope was used to collect vibration data of the wheeled robot during uniform motion under different fault conditions, and the data set was fabricated. The ResNet is trained and tested using TTS and image as input, and the results show that the latter performs better. Comparing the training and testing results of five commonly used neural network models, including ResNet, using the same datasets, shows that the use of ResNet in this paper is superior in terms of parameter training and testing results. It is concluded that the intermediate features extracted by IIRB are more diverse, which is verified on open-source datasets.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Soil Oil Concentration Based on Wavelet Kurtosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the prediction problem of oil pollutant concentration on soil surface, oil spectral curve was obtained by laser induced fluorescence technology. Based on kurtosis, skewness and standard deviation, wavelet kurtosis was proposed as the quantitative parameter to predict the concentration of contaminated oil on soil surface. The random forest regression algorithm was used to compare and analyze three different oil products in the market. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of three kinds of oil concentration by random forest regression model is improved by 6.67%, 6.66% and 3.33% respectively. It provides some reference for the regression model of predicting the concentration of oil pollutants in soil surface.

articleTitle: Research on Workpiece Corner Detection Method based on Combination Method Image Feature Points
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To improve the workpiece localization accuracy, the paper proposes an improved image alignment optimization method by random sample consensus (RANSAC) and selecting some point pairs with high confidence from them, and then calculating the affine transformation matrix separately using the combination method to filter the optimal affine transformation matrix algorithm. The image is preprocessed. First, the grayscale image is filtered with a median to remove the noise, and the scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) detection algorithm is used to obtain the image feature points and perform feature point matching; the more decisive matching points are coarsely selected by the distance threshold between the matched feature point pairs, and the more decisive matching points are chosen from Several teams of issues are selected from the more decisive matching points. The base image transformation matrix is calculated respectively, specific methods filter the better matrix, and the better rotation angle is calculated. The accuracy and stability of the algorithm are verified through experiments, and the experimental results show that the error of the rotation angle of the workpiece is within 0.1° and the algorithm's running time is within 1 ms.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Range of High End Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This article focuses on the basic concept of the dynamic range of vector network analyzers, the important factors that affect the dynamic range, and several main methods to improve the dynamic range. The dynamic range characterizes the ability of vector network analyzers to measure the transmission parameters of the DUT, and is one of the indicators that users are very concerned about. Especially in recent years, the improvement in the accuracy requirements of the DUT has put forward higher requirements for the dynamic range of the system. The same dynamic range can be tested with a larger intermediate frequency bandwidth, thereby improving the testing speed.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Electricity Metering Equipment R&D Ability Based on NQI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Currently, there are many international evaluation methods about product quality, but few evaluation methods about product R&D ability, especially in the field of electric energy measurement. Based on the study of the internationally accepted quality evaluation methods, combining the measurement, standard and conformity assessment in the National Quality Infrastructure(NQI), an evaluation method for the R&D ability of electricity metering equipments is proposed, and the evaluation indexes are quantified and analyzed experimentally. The results show that this method can objectively evaluate the R&D ability of electricity metering equipment manufacturers, and provide a basis for the development of electricity metering equipment industry and the improvement of manufacturers' own R&D abilities.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Analysis of Novel Magnetic Control Switch and Mechanical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper focuses on the modeling and simulation of a novel magnetic control mechanism for a 12kV column circuit breaker. Firstly, the mechanical principles of the new magnetic control mechanism are introduced, and a dynamic model is established. A virtual prototype is constructed using multibody dynamics software ADAMS for dynamic simulation. Based on the simulation results, corresponding optimization directions are proposed to meet the mechanical performance requirements of the control mechanism. This study provides a theoretical basis and practical guidance for the research on the operating mechanism of column vacuum circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Design of Thermal Conductivity Gas Sensor with Silicon Cap
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a suspended micro hotplate-based thermal conductivity gas sensor. A rectangular silicon cap is packaged above the micro hotplate, creating a 20μm air gap. This design increases the proportion of heat dissipation through gaseous thermal conduction in the total heat dissipation of the chip, significantly improving the sensitivity of gas detection. By comparing the differences in total thermal conductivity between the chip with the cap and without it, it can be observed that gas conduction, directly related to gas concentration, constitutes more than 91% of the total thermal conductivity. Through evaluations conducted on a mixture of nitrogen gas with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SF}_6$</tex> and H2, the chip with the silicon cap demonstrated effective detection of changes in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SF}_{6}$</tex> at 200ppm and H2 at 50ppm.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Anemometer Calibration of Two Kinds of Wind Tunnel Devices with Different Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces two kinds of wind speed measuring devices for anemometer traceability, analyzes the structure, advantages and disadvantages of different devices. The structure of the wind tunnel type velocity area method gas flow standard device is a direct flow wind tunnel, which is easy to maintain, the stability time required to adjust the wind speed is fast, and it is easy to quickly adjust the different wind speeds, but the power requirements of the fan are large, and the noise of the fan will be relatively large during the detection. The structure of the annular wind tunnel device is closed single return flow, which can recycle the air in the wind tunnel, improve the air utilization rate, reduce energy consumption, and maintain good uniformity and stability in the whole wind tunnel. Analysis device uncertainty, and compare the values of the anemometers of the two devices. The results show that it is feasible for the two devices to trace the magnitude of the anemometer.

Author Keywords: wind tunnel type velocity area method gas flow standard device

articleTitle: Evaluation of In-Orbit Index System for Satellite Flywheels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: On-orbit performance evaluation of satellite flywheel is an important part of satellite equipment evaluation. By analyzing the characteristics and difficulties of on-orbit performance evaluation of satellite flywheel, the on-orbit performance evaluation method and index evaluation algorithm based on on-orbit telemetry data are given. Based on the test data evaluation system of the satellite platform of Shanghai Satellite Engineering Research Institute, the flywheel index evaluation model is designed, and the sample data selection and verification are completed. The results show that the flywheel on-orbit performance evaluation technology can scientifically and quantitatively calculate the on-orbit indexes of the flywheel, and better distinguish the on-orbit performance characteristics of various types of flywheels, which has good reference value for the on-orbit performance evaluation of satellite single-machine products and the analysis of single-machine on-orbit performance of the type spectrum.

articleTitle: Testing and Analysis of Electromagnetic Interference on BPL Near-Field Timing Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Compared with satellite timing service, BPL timing service has strong anti-interference capability, which is the best backup and supplementary for satellites. In order to verify the high stability of near-field timing service, the paper set up an experiment to test electromagnetic interference on BPL receiving within 100km radius. The results showed closer to high-power equipment such as air-conditioning reduced the signal amplitude over 70%, and timing precision appeared microseconds jumping to be unstable. Even in the near-field environment within 30km radius, the strong-power equipment such as the 5G base station easily reduced the electric field intensity over 40%, and the receivers might lost tracking and fail to timing. In conclusion the paper gave the suggestion of selecting BPL receiver location.

articleTitle: Correction of the Beam Hardening Artifacts in CT Images Using Pix2pixGAN Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the noncoincidence between the mono energetic rays-based reconstruction algorithms and the multi-energy projection data, there always exit beam hardening artifacts destroying the reconstructed CT images. A correction of the beam hardening artifacts can effectively enhance the accuracy and reliability of the scan results. In this preliminary study, we propose a pix2pixGAN generative adversarial network to do this work. Compared to the traditional approaches, this method can increase the structural similarity index measure by 11.81%, improve the decrease the peak signal-to-noise ratio by 25.59% and decrease the root-mean-square error by 62.02<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. These results demonstrate that the pix2pixGAN generative adversarial network can simultaneously correct the artifacts and improve the recovery of details.

articleTitle: A Metering Device for DC Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper describes a metering device for DC energy meters. This device is used for measuring voltage, current and electrical energy of electric vehicle DC charging point. The device realizes the measurement of high DC current by using magnetic modulation DC current comparator. The DC voltage measurement range of this device is 3V~750V, and the DC current measurement range is 0.2A ~ 500A. The measurement results show that the DC electrical energy error of this device is blow 0.02<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the stability is better than 0.01%/min.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Pulsed Eddy Current Detection Signal of Thermal Barrier Coatings Thickness Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A study is conducted on the detection signal utilized to measure the thickness of thermal barrier coatings (TBCs) with pulsed eddy current (PEC) technology. Via the definition of sensitivity of thermal barrier coatings thickness measurement, an analysis is conducted to determine the influence of the inside diameter, width, and height of the excitation and detection coil on sensitivity. To obtain the optimal parameters of the excitation and detection coil, the response surface method in the Design Expert software is utilized. In addition, an analysis is conducted to determine the influence of the lift-off effect on the pulsed eddy current detection signal of the thermal barrier coatings. In order to minimize the impact of the lift-off effect on the detection signal, a two-stage difference method was proposed as a preprocessing step. Through the simulation experiment, it is found that when inner diameter is increased, width is widened, and height is reduced, the sensitivity of thickness measurement is heightened accordingly, if the number of coil turns remain constant and the geometry parameters of the excitation and detection coil are constrained within a particular range. Besides, coil height has a more significant effect on sensitivity than other factors. Sensors optimized by the response surface method have higher sensitivity when measuring the thickness of thermal barrier coatings. The impact of the lift-off effect is significant on the detection signal, and the two-stage difference method can efficiently minimize the effect.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Field Gradient Suppression Methods in Magnetically Shielded Room
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The suppression of gradient magnetic fields (GMF) in magnetically shielded room (MSR) can provide the necessary conditions for precision physics experiments, biomagnetic signal measurements and zero-magnetic science research. The bi-planar coil designed by using the target field method (TFM) can generate a high-precision controlled compensating GMF within a certain target area, thus suppressing the original GMF and ultimately increasing the uniformity inside the MSR. In this paper, a total of 5 gradient bi-planar coils (GBC) are designed by using the particle swarm algorithm (PSO) to suppress the GMF, and the effectiveness of the design is demonstrated by finite element simulation. The results show that the gradient bi-planar coils (GBCs) design can effectively suppress the GMF in all directions within the MSR.

articleTitle: Inspection Method for Standard Conformance of Two-Way Satellite Time Comparison Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Two-way satellite time comparison is a common method to realize high-precision time and frequency comparison between two stations. It can meet user's demand for comparison precision of few nanoseconds and has good real-time performance. Two-way satellite time comparison terminal is the core of time comparison system. The terminals produced by various manufacturers have different interfaces and impassable protocols, resulting in poor interconnection and intercommunication between different manufacturers' products, which seriously affects the time comparison between different terminals produced by various manufacturers. In order to solve the problem, inspection method for standard conformance of two-way satellite time comparison terminal is proposed innovatively in the paper. This method takes the current relevant national standards as inspection basis. Through testing the interfaces and protocols of the two-way satellite time comparison terminal, the conformance between the inspected terminal and the selected inspection basis is analyzed and inspection report is obtained. The method effectively solves the problems of poor interconnection and intercommunication between products of different manufacturers. The inspection results can provide reference for the networking of the two-way satellite time comparison terminal. Further, it can promote the standardized application of two-way satellite time comparison equipment.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Evaluation of Oscilloscope Measurement Waveform Based on Covariance Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Accurate waveform metrology and uncertainty assessment are essential in modern communication, optical, and high-frequency electronic industries. The uncertainty assessment of pulse waveform measurements has traditionally focused on evaluating the uncertainties of pulse parameters without considering the complete waveform uncertainty. Singular pulse parameters sometimes fail to fully characterize a measurement system. In this paper, a method based on the covariance matrix is employed to assess the uncertainty of the complete waveform obtained by an oscilloscope. After obtaining the uncertainty of the complete waveform measurement results, pulse parameters are extracted. By utilizing the principles of uncertainty propagation, the uncertainty of pulse parameters is assessed. Monte Carlo simulation (MCM) is used to validate the uncertainty of pulse parameters.

articleTitle: Tire Radiogram Defect Detection Based on ESSNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To address the issue that tire defects cannot be accurately localized in tire defect detection, an intelligent tire defect detection model based on simple semantic segmentation (ESSNet) is studied, which consists of a simple encoder-decoder network and a multi-scale residual refinement module, responsible for anticipating the tire X-ray coarse feature map and refining the coarse feature map mapping, respectively. Additionally, a hybrid loss function is employed to achieve more precise localization limits for the object to be recognized, and a texture segmentation approach is used to minimize the complexity of the tire X-ray image. It is demonstrated that the model is capable of precisely locating and segmenting the defects in the tire pictures and achieving a mPA score of 86.24 % on the test set.

articleTitle: Method of Measuring Critical Flow Venturi Nozzle with Piston Gas Flow Standard Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces a method of testing critical flow venturi nozzle with piston type gas flow standard device. The traditional testing methods for critical flow venturi nozzle are divided into real flow verification method and geometrical verification method. The existing real flow verification method is generally carried out on pVTt gas flow standard device. By comparing the two testing methods from the aspect of testing principle, it is found that it is feasible for the device to transmit volume to the nozzle through uncertainty analysis, The test result of nozzle of piston gas flow standard device and the test result of pVTt method are verified, and the EN value meets the requirement. The piston-type gas flow standard device is used to transmit the nozzle volume, which greatly improves the efficiency of nozzle volume transmission. When there are problems such as misalignment or incomplete sealing during nozzle clamping, it can be found quickly; However, due to the limited cylinder size and motor speed of the piston unit, its flow is limited and it is impossible to measure nozzles with excessive flow.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Field Compensation Method Based on Fuzzy PI Control for Low Remanence in Magnetic Shielding Room
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: An active magnetic compensation method based on passive shielding is used for low remanence and interfering field suppression in a lower cost magnetic shielding room (MSR). In this paper, a compensation coil control strategy with conventional PI and fuzzy PI segmentation control is proposed, and an active magnetic compensation system with a linearized model is built using an external high uniformity Helmholtz coil. The result shows that the compensation system has a greatly improvement in the suppression of the interfering magnetic field in the environment while ensuring good step response performance of the controller.

articleTitle: Planar Coil Oil Monitoring Sensor Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Since lubricating fluid detection is an easy and reliable method of keeping track of the condition of machinery and equipment, inductive sensors have been employed extensively to find small metal particles in oil fluids. In this work, we suggest a sensor that uses a transverse induction coil mounted on a single flat coil, with the coil structure optimized by numerical computation. Multiple detection flow channels are proposed as a way to improve detection flow. Experimental results have demonstrated that the designed sensor can detect the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$150\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> ferric particles and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$400\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> non-ferric particles in a single 7mm diameter tube.

articleTitle: Online Analyzer for Monitoring of Heavy Metals in Groundwater Using Diffusive Gradients in Thin Films and X-Ray Fluorescence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper aims at meeting the increasing demand of heavy metal monitoring in groundwater. An online analyzer is developed using diffusive gradients in thin films (DGT) and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) techniques. Compare to the spectrophotometric method and the anodic stripping method, the developed analyzer has the advantage of low reagent consumption and can measure multiple metallic parameters simultaneously. A novel analysis procedure including clipping, immersing, enriching and XRF analyzing of a DGT device is described in the paper. The procedure is automated by a IAC2000 PLC system. Experiments were undertaken to verify the performance of the analyzer. Cr and Pb were chosen to assess the repeatability, accuracy and limit of detection of the analyzer. A repeatability of 5%, accuracy of 10% and limit of detection of 0.15mg/L is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of Airborne Target Missile Testing System and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This article elaborates on the testing system design for near space target missiles based on their testing characteristics. Compared to conventional missiles, target missiles reduce the requirements for searching and destroying targets, but have stricter requirements for flight trajectory and altitude. Therefore, the key point of target missile testing system design is to focus on verifying core indicators and eliminating irrelevant testing content. In addition, for airborne target missiles, this article proposes several future development directions in testing technology.

articleTitle: Research on Resampling of Wideband Zero-IF Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The problem of sampling rate conversion in wideband Zero Intermediate Frequency (Zero-IF) receiver is considered. The purpose of digital resampling technology is to realize digital signal sampling rate conversion, which is widely used in bandwidth filter design in spectrum analysis, noise suppression in modulation and demodulation technology, etc. However, in most usage scenarios, the required sampling rate conversion is not integer multiple conversion. Combined with the system architecture requirements of wideband Zero-IF receivers, this paper designs an arbitrary magnification resampling algorithm with relatively little hardware resource consumption and relatively high accuracy. After the test of the system platform, the feasibility of the arbitrary magnification resampling algorithm designed in this paper is verified, which provides a guarantee for the correct detection and analysis of subsequent signals.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Sensor Array Payload for UAV Bridge Concrete Surface Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Bridges with concrete structures are prone to phenomena such as cracking, which poses a significant threat to railway operational safety. Currently, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) has been employed for bridge health monitoring. However, the existing UAV payloads are not specifically designed for bridge inspection and encounter several issues during operation. In light of this, this paper proposes a low-power, omni-directional vision payload specifically designed for bridge inspection. The payload is equipped with four cameras, a laser rangefinder, a millimeter-wave radar, an RTK (Real-Time Kinematic), inertial navigation system, and a high-performance computing platform. It enables real-time acquisition, detection, and annotation of crack information on the sides and underside of bridges, while offering an extended flight time. Moreover, experimental results have demonstrated that the payload can discern targets with a width of 0.19 mm at a distance of 20 m from the bridge.

articleTitle: Asymmetrical De-Embedding Method for Millimeter-Wave On-Wafer Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to accurate characterize millimeter wave IC circuits, de-embedding methods have been proposed to eliminate the parasitic effects of test fixtures. L-2L de-embedding method has been wildly applied to RF on wafer measurement due to its convenience. However its accuracy is not acceptable at very high frequencies. This is largely because its equivalent circuit model is symmetric, which is too simple to describe the RF pads parasitic effects. In this paper, an asymmetrical de-embedding method for millimeter-wave measurement is proposed based on traditional L-2L de-embedding method. The proposed method takes asymmetry into account when extracting parasitic parameters. It overcomes the disadvantage of the conventional de-embedding method. The equivalent-circuit and analysis methods are also given. An asymmetrical transmission line and its de-embedding fixture are fabricated with photosensitive composite film via a multilayer wiring process. The de-embedded results show that the proposed method is more accurate than the traditional L-2L method.

articleTitle: Recognition of Coal and Rock Properties for Coal Mine Drilling Rig Based on Electromagnetic Wave Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The identification of coal and rock properties in coal mine drilling is the key technology to improve the accuracy of coal seam detection, the efficiency of gas drainage and the effect of drillhole destressing. In order to solve a series of problems in the process of coal mining drilling and mining, this paper designed a small size coaxial feed microstrip antenna with a working frequency of 5.6GHz that can be used on a specific drill pipe, and established a multi-slot drill pipe model that can be installed with microstrip antenna. CST microwave studio was used to simulate the drilling state, and the differences of reflected wave signals of 6 kinds of coal lithologic materials, such as lignite, bituminous coal, anthracite, shale, mudstone and sandstone were analyzed, which provided help for the identification of coal and rock properties by electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: Application of Turbidity Compensation Model in Total Nitrogen Water Quality Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As one of internationally recognized important indicator to measure the degree of eutrophication of water bodies, the total nitrogen represents the total content of organic nitrogen and inorganic nitrogen (NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> +NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>+NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>) in water. Its content can reflect the degree of pollution of water bodies. As a national standard method for measuring total nitrogen content in water, ultraviolet spectrophotometry has the advantages of high sensitivity and small error. But when the turbidity of the measured water body is high, the results of this measurement method will be severely affected, and even show negative values. In this paper, a turbidity compensation model based on full-spectrum spectrophotometry is proposed. The sensitive wavelength band that can reflect the turbidity of water is determined by experiments, and the quantitative relationship between the absorption spectrum intensity and the absorbance introduced by turbidity is established. Under this model, the 1 mg/L total nitrogen standard solution with different turbidity was tested and analyzed. The average absolute error between the predicted value and the real value was 5.25 %, indicating that this model has the potential to be applied in the total nitrogen analyzer to achieve anti-turbidity function.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Adjustment System of Pipette Capacity Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In response to the problems of the large workload of pipette calibration, low efficiency and errors introduced by manual long-term operation, the automatic adjustment system of pipette capacity is achieved by using a servo motor driven rotatable gripper to automatically adjust the capacity, together with machine vision as a tool to identify the pipette capacity value. More than 20 different types of pipettes are experimentally performed on automatic adjustment system, and the results show that the accuracy of the system can reach 100%, verifying the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Self-Shielding Uniform Coils Based on Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The ferromagnetic boundary coupling effect is an important factor affecting the coil uniformity, and the non-moment coils (NMCs) design method is often used to solve this problem. This paper proposes a non-moment planar coils (NMPCs) design method based on bat algorithm (BA) and self-shielding method, which can inhibit the coupling effect between the coils and the high magnetic permeability shielding layer, and improve the uniformity of the target region. We design Bx and Bz NMPCs, and use finite element software to simulate and calculate, verifying the performance of the method. Compared with ordinary planar coils (OPCs) in the shielding layer, the target region uniformity of this method has been significantly improved, Bx and Bz have increased by a factor of 17.28 and 10.57 respectively. This method can provide a new coil design idea for precise ultra-weak magnetic testing.

articleTitle: NX MCD-Based Unboxing Machine Model Design and Virtual Commissioning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The design of the existing unboxing machine needs to refer to the field environment to assist the assembly, and it also takes a lot of time to debug the equipment, so the virtual debugging technology can save the time and reduce the risk of the actual debugging. The modeling module of NX software was used to build the unboxing machine model, and the simulation parameters were set up in the electromechanical concept design module to establish the TCP communication between the virtual PLC in PLCSIM Advanced and the 3D model in the electromechanical concept design module. It verifies the rationality of designing the unboxing machine solution in NX and the feasibility of virtual debugging in the MCD module, which provides an auxiliary means for the design and debugging of production lines and promotes the development of industrial automation.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Flexible Electronic Processing Equipment Performance Degradation Trend Forecast
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In response to the issues of a single construction method for flexible electronic processing equipment performance indicators, lack of performance indicator information, and low accuracy in predicting performance degradation trends, this article proposes a prediction method based on the degradation trend of equipment performance using self-encoding coders and multi-header attention mechanisms. This method first extracts multiple types of mechanism characteristics from the original vibration signal, taking into consideration their monotonicity, robustness, and correlation, and selects virtual features that are conducive to performance prediction. Secondly, to address the issue of redundant characteristic information, a self-encoding coder is utilized to integrate these features and construct performance indicators. Additionally, the combination of a multi-header attention mechanism and long short-term memory (LSTM) network is investigated to enhance the weighting of important degradation information and disregard redundant information, thus addressing the limitations of existing models. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed performance prediction method is validated through experiments conducted on a bearing dataset.

articleTitle: Weld Image Evaluation Model Using Improved Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a study focused on the problem of evaluating the quality of weld seams in the context of metalworking practice. The main challenges encountered in this task are the high similarity between weld images and the presence of inconspicuous grading boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose a novel loss function that incorporates the VGG16-SVM and Mask R-CNN models, incorporating multiple classifications and introducing central loss and isolation loss terms. To construct a comprehensive sample dataset, various image data types were acquired, followed by data enhancement, size modification, normalization, and other preprocessing operations on the weld images. Finally, practical validation experiments were conducted using two different models, in combination with the improved loss function model. The experimental results provide compelling evidence for the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved 3D Reconstruction of PCBA Using FPP: Specular Area Reconstruction & Shadow Area Removal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In modern electronics manufacturing, the inspection and analysis of printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA) is crucial for ensuring product quality and reliability. Three-dimensional (3D) shape reconstruction of PCBA has become a rapidly emerging research area and a critical task in this process. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on fringe projection profilometry for reconstructing the 3D shape of PCBA. In order to address the challenges posed by specular and shadow areas, the proposed approach employs multi-exposure fringe projection fusion to recover the specular areas while minimizing the impact of saturation. And a modified error energy function is proposed to identify and eliminate shadow regions, thereby enhancing the accuracy and robustness of the reconstructed 3D model. Finally, the 3D shapes of the PCBA are reconstructed using the Photometric Stereo based calibration model proposed previously by us. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively reconstruct the 3D shape of PCBA with high accuracy and reliability. The proposed method has significant potential for practical applications in the electronics manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Research on Technology of Shock Tube Active Film Breaking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Pressure sensors are widely used in various fields of social economy and production and life. The calibration and testing of dynamic pressure performance are usually carried out by using the step pressure generated by shock tube. Natural and active film breaking are the main ways to generate shock step pressure by shock tube. Compared with the natural film breaking technology, the active film breaking technology can control the dynamic parameters of the step pressure, shock wave velocity and response characteristics through the control of the film pressure ratio, and further improve the reliability of the dynamic calibration performance of the shock tube. This paper only introduces the principle and performance of different structures of the active film breaking device, and through different structures and blocking ratio of the film breaking device test, study and analysis of the impact of active film breaking technology on the shock wave waveform, for different calibration requirements for the dynamic pressure performance of the pressure sensor, so as to select the appropriate active film breaking technology to provide a reference.

articleTitle: 5G Positioning Method Based on Finite Rate of Innovation Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Although the 5G positioning accuracy has been greatly improved due to the support of technologies such as large bandwidth and massive MIMO, it also brings a problem that the receiver needs to process massive amounts of data to obtain the position information of user equipment (UE). The finite rate of innovation (FRI) sampling theory can recover unknown information of signals through a small number of samples. In order to reduce the amount of data that needs to be processed during the 5G positioning process and effectively estimate the position of UE, this paper proposes a 5G positioning method based on FRI sampling. A FRI sampling structure for sounding reference signal (SRS) is proposed in this paper, and a signal arrival time reconstruction algorithm for this sampling structure is proposed. Finally, based on the estimated signal arrival time parameters, the position estimation of UE can be obtained by solving the positioning equation. The simulation results show that under certain conditions, this method can significantly reduce the sampling rate while maintaining positioning accuracy at the sub meter level. This article also analyzes the impact of factors such as the number of samples and sampling interval on the performance of this method.

articleTitle: Stream of Variation Modeling Method for Turbine Blade in the Investment Casting Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Investment casting turbine blade is an important component which affect the performance of aero-engines with their complex structural design, cumbersome manufacturing processes and frequent state changes. But the investment casting turbine blade final product has low accuracy and a high rate of waste, which seriously affects the production and development capabilities of Chinese aero-engines. To solve this problem, this study proposes a stream of variation model construction method for the entire investment casting process of turbine blade. Based on the state space theory, this method constructs the stream of variation models for the four states in the investment casting process and the dimensional variation prediction of each link which are influenced by the Multi-source and heterogeneous variation is realized. The feasibility of the stream of variation model in practical applications was verified through ICT (Industrial Computed Tomography) simulation experiments using approximated blade constructed by the real blade cross-sectional lines. Finally, the heuristic algorithm was added to the stream of variation model to optimize the parameter search process to improve the applicability of the model. This method implements the real-time prediction of variations at each stage and provides an important tool for quality control of investment casting turbine blade.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement and Evaluation Technology of Thread Pitch Diameter Based on Extended Virtual Three Ball Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The thread pitch diameter is an important parameter to measure the thread manufacturing accuracy. In order to effectively measure and evaluate the thread pitch value which satisfies the actual thread fit effect by using machine vision, this paper presents an extended virtual three ball method combined with standard thread profile to measure thread pitch diameter. In this method, the middle diameter model of the extended virtual three ball method is constructed on the shaft section, and then the standard thread tooth profile matched with the actual thread profile is obtained. the extended virtual three ball method is applied to the standard tooth profile to obtain the center diameter value which is closer to the actual effect. Finally, the average relative error and standard deviation are used as evaluation indexes to evaluate the center diameter values of different experimental equipment. The experimental results show that the relative error between the middle diameter value measured by the image measuring instrument and the middle diameter value obtained by the comprehensive thread measuring instrument is stable at 3.3 μm, which provides an efficient and reliable measuring method for machine vision to measure the middle diameter of screw thread.

articleTitle: A Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Fault Diagnosis Method for Wind Turbine Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Fault monitoring of wind turbine bearings effectively reduces wind turbine downtime, and intelligent diagnosis methods have attracted attention from researchers in recent years. However, these methods still have shortcomings, such as over-reliance on expert experience. To address these problems, this paper proposes a single-agent reinforcement learning fault diagnostic method for wind turbine bearings. This method constructs an end-to-end fault diagnostic model, which outputs corresponding fault states by learning the continuous wavelet transform scalograms of original vibration signals. The agent uses an SAE network to approximate the optimal Q function, and experience replay and iterative update strategies are used in the training process. After ten-fold cross-validation, the fault diagnosis agent's accuracies are about 89%, which is superior to the traditional intelligent diagnosis method. This paper also visualizes the fault diagnosis results in T-SNE, and the results indicate that the method in this paper can effectively reflect the nonlinear relations between vibration signals and fault states, which has greater application prospects in the wind turbine bearing fault diagnosis task.

articleTitle: Novel GNSS Anti-Spoofing Technique Using Antenna Array Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel antenna array-based spoofing defense scheme for the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) is developed in this paper. The basis of the proposed approach is the spatial processing, which can be divided into two successive steps. In the first step, to identify and suppress the spoofing under the noise level, we build a cyclic correlation matrix to provide the direction of arrival (DOA) of the incoming signals. A robust adaptive beamforming process based on eigenspace projection is then designed to eliminate the spoofing in the second step. In particular, the proposed technique is capable of adaptively eliminating spoofing while providing protection to the desired navigation signals. By exploiting the digitised baseband signals, our framework avoids acquiring and tracking all arriving signals, reducing the receiver's computational load. The effectiveness of our anti-spoofing strategy is illustrated by the simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Detection Method Based on WOLA Structure with Matched Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: At high sampling rates, the data throughput is large, and part of the data will be discarded because the data cannot be processed in real time, which leads to an increase in the probability of missing transitory signals. On the other hand, in practical test scenarios, the measured signal often has the characteristics of frequency domain sparseness, and the signal of interest is often located in a specific frequency band. Therefore, in this paper, a matching filtering frequency domain detection method based on the WOLA structure is proposed. The high-efficiency WOLA structure is used to decompose the signal according to different frequency bands. The output signal of each sub-frequency band is matched and filtered to extract the signal of interest from the noise. And the best judgment basis is provided at the detection time. According to the determined frequency domain position information, the system can filter out the signal of interest and prevent the risk of missing occasional signals, and solve the problem of high data throughput faced by transient signal processing in the time domain at high sampling rates. In the experiment, the pulse frequency hopping signal is used to verify the effectiveness, and the results show the effectiveness of the proposed detection method.

articleTitle: Research on Self-Learning Flaw Detection in Ultrasonic C-Scan Non-Destructive Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The ultrasonic C-scan technique is widely utilized for corrosion monitoring of metal plates and pipelines due to its ability to generate comprehensible images of flaws. However, the application of this technique has been challenging because of the large-scale and unbalanced signals reflected from the tested objects. In this paper, we present a method for identifying ultrasonic response signals of defects using an ultrasonic detection with contrastive learning (UD-CL) framework. This self-learning framework is used to unsupervisedly learn latent representations of echo signals obtained from ultrasonic C-scans. The algorithm addresses both the imbalance in the distribution of raw echo data and the lack of sufficient annotated ultrasonic signals. The UD-CL method consists of two components: a feature extractor based on a convolutional network and a learnable nonlinear transformation layer, which are used to obtain an efficient latent representation and perform contrastive optimization, respectively. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach by applying it to an aluminum plate with various types of flaws. The results show that the UD-CL outperforms previous deep learning techniques in terms of accuracy in identifying the location and category of flaws when trained using only 10% of the labels.

articleTitle: Software and Hardware Co-Design Method for Ship Detection in Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The on-board processing of ship target detection in remote sensing images can transmit the detection results directly back to the ground and obtain fast processing speed. However, the increase in the amount of remote sensing image data leads to the decrease in the timeliness of on-board remote sensing image ship detection. In this article, a software and hardware co-design method for target detection in remote sensing images is proposed. In this method, the processing system in Zynq system on chip (SoC) is used for pre-processing as well as integration and output of detection results, and the programmable logic in Zynq SoC is used for accelerating the MobileNetV3 target detection method. The experimental results show the proposed method can accomplish satisfying ship detection of remote sensing images. Meanwhile, the average processing time of a remote sensing image of 64 * 64 size is 2.59 ms, which is a relatively fast processing speed.

articleTitle: Online Wind Speed Measurement System and Test Method for Chemical Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: When we work in the chemical scene, people should measure the wind speed according to the actual situation of the closed space, and conduct regular detection or continuous monitoring, while there are usually many toxic, harmful, flammable and explosive gases in the closed space in the chemical scene. At present, the on-line measurement technology of wind speed is insufficient at low flow velocity. Specifically, the regularity and signal strength of the vortex train generated by the device are very weak, and the signal can hardly be detected, so the measurement cannot be realized. This measuring system has been provided with bionic convex structure, which has drag reduction effect and can overcome the problem that the speed of gas and solid contact surface is slow and cannot be measured.

articleTitle: Research on Interpretation and Monitoring Method of On-Orbit Satellite Telemetry Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to reduce the dependence of satellites on ground stations, improve the utilization of orbital resources, and implement constellation network communication, the satellite launch mode has changed to a rapid batch launch mode, and the number of on-orbit monitoring satellites has increased from hundreds to thousands. Traditional telemetry and monitoring systems are facing new challenges. How to efficiently perform data interpretation and status monitoring on satellites and batch-produced satellites is an important issue at present. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes an interpretation and monitoring method based on baseline data, defines different baseline forms according to business scenarios, and adopts “three steps”-state saltus detection, threshold convergence judgment, and similarity analysis method to implement the state interpretation of satellite telemetry data. At the same time, a method of aggregated interpretation and monitoring is proposed for the real-time monitoring of the consistency of batch-produced satellite telemetry data. On this basis, a satellite telemetry real-time interpretation monitoring software system is designed. The above method has been verified on this system.

articleTitle: Mixed Precision Quantized Neural Network Accelerator for Remote Sensing Images Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The application of convolutional neural network (CNN) for classifying optical remote sensing images holds great significance in areas such as maritime management, environmental protection, and more. However, the significant computational demands of CNN pose obstacles to the efficient deployment at the edge. Quantization techniques, as effective model compression methods, have been widely used to reduce computational demands during model deployment. Current uniform low-precision quantization methods suffer from significant accuracy loss. Mixed-precision quantization compresses models while maintaining accuracy, but it introduces computations with multiple bit widths. Due to the introduction of multiple bit-width computations, general-purpose computing platforms are unable to leverage the computational efficiency of quantized network. In this article, a Zynq SoC-based mixed-precision neural network accelerator design is proposed, which can fully leverage its energy efficiency. Experimental results show that the mixed-precision neural network accelerator achieves 4.96 × improvement in inference speed compared with the baseline.

articleTitle: Correlation Comparison Testing between Traffic Speed Deflectometer and Falling Weight Deflectometer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) has a significant potential to replace traditional deflection measuring instruments such as Falling Weight Deflectometer (FWD). However, due to the lack of experimental roads that can provide standard deflection values, quantitative evaluation of this advanced nondestructive measurement instrument still faces specific difficulties. For this reason, the paper designed and carried out three sets of comparison tests for two TSDs (manufactured by GreenWood of Denmark and Beijing Luxing of China, respectively) and one FWD (Model: CarlBro PRI2100): repeatability, speed variability, and correlation with FWD. When analyzing the experimental data, the representative deflection value of a section of road is proposed to replace the deflection of a single position, which avoids the problems caused by direct quantitative analysis of measured values. Especially in the correlation analysis, a data grouping method is proposed to divide the measurement values of three instruments on the same test pavement into 14 groups, and the correlation between the two TSDs and FWD is studied based on the correlation coefficients between the representative deflection values. The experimental results indicate that TSD, a new type of nondestructive testing instrument for road surfaces, has good repeatability, low speed dependence, and high correlation with FWD. The grouped pavement data can be characterized as multiple test roads with different deflection ranges, reducing the experimental test requirements of TSD. The new comparison method can avoid misjudgment caused by differences in measuring principles, operating procedures, data collection modes, and processing algorithms of instruments.

articleTitle: Research on the Conformity of Error Value of Wind Direction Sensor Measurement in Automatic Weather Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In view of the current lack of research on the conformity determination of the measurement results of wind direction sensors in automatic weather stations. According to the working principle of the EL-2C automatic weather station wind direction sensor, a corresponding experimental scheme is designed, and a corresponding measurement model is established according to its experimental process. The uncertainty of its measurement results is evaluated using the GUM method. The expanded uncertainty <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U_{95}$</tex> values of the corresponding error values for each measurement point are obtained in the range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(2.1^{\circ}\sim 2.6^{\circ})$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(2.2^{\circ}\sim 2.6^{\circ})$</tex> respectively, and the results meet the basic requirements for evaluating the error compliance of the measuring instrument. This method fills the gap in the current research on the conformity determination of wind direction sensor measurement results at automatic weather stations, improves the reliability of wind direction sensor measurement results at automatic weather stations, and provides technical support to ensure the accuracy of wind direction detection data.

articleTitle: A Small Target Detection Method on Sea Surface Based on Markov Transition Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In response to the limitations of manually extracting features from target signals in the background of sea clutter, this paper studies Markov transition fields and convolutional neural networks, and proposes a sea small target detection method based on Markov transition fields, which transforms the detection problem into a binary classification problem. The one-dimensional observation echo is transformed into a two-dimensional image through the Markov transition field, and a sea clutter and weak signal classification model is established to complete the task of detecting weak signals in sea clutter. Taking IPIX measured radar data as the experimental object, a transfer learning model is built to autonomously learn MTF image features, improve the performance of the ResNet model, reduce training costs, compare the effects of different sampling points on detection results, and find that the effect is optimal when the sampling point is 1024. Compared with other image coding methods and classification networks, the proposed method can deeply explore the differences between targets and clutter, and has better detection and classification performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Pattern Synthesis Based on FPGA and DAC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a design for a multi-level pattern generator based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and Digital to Analog Converter (DAC). The proposed generator utilizes dynamic time error control to synthesize multi-level and pseudo-random bit sequence (PRBS) coding patterns, thereby expanding the application range of the pattern generator. To overcome the limited speed of FPGA logic resources and achieve a sample rate of 1.25 giga samples per second (GSPS) for the DAC, the design incorporates eight parallel channels of a processing unit. Experimental results demonstrate that the pattern generator can synthesize pattern signals at rates up to 120 mega samples per second (MBd) with voltage magnitudes of 2-level, 3-level, and 4-level.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Method Based on CGAN and CNN-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To a certain extent, the Internet has substantially enriched people's life due to its convenience. At the same time, cyber-attacks are common and pose a significant threat to personal privacy and public safety. Real-time detection and warning of network behavior and traffic are crucial for network security. A network intrusion detection (NID) method, known as CGAN-CBiLSTM, was developed to adapt to the requirements of the current network environment. In our algorithm, the conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN) was combined with the convolutional neural network (CNN) and bi-directional long short-term memory neural network (BiLSTM). In data preprocessing, raw traffic data was mapped into the gaussian domain. CGAN can generate virtual samples based on specified labels to build balanced traffic datasets. In the hybrid neural network, CNN and BiLSTM were mainly responsible for extracting the temporal and spatial features of the traffic. Experiments on the NSL-KDD dataset verified the proposed method, and the classification accuracy, precision, f1-score, and FAR can achieve 88.25%, 96.61%, 88.7%, and 3.7%, respectively. Our algorithm considered the data imbalance problem and designed a suitable model structure. As a result, CGAN-CBiLSTM achieved high accuracy in the NID task.
