articleTitle: Surface Anomaly Detection Based on Multi-Scale Feature Propagation and Normalized Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Unsupervised learning is widely used for surface anomaly detection, due to the sparse and difficult description of anomaly samples. The goal of this paper is to improve the problems of low accuracy and slow speed in unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms. Starting off, the pre-trained convolutional neural network with large dataset is used for feature coarse extraction. Then, a multiscale feature propagation architecture is constructed to perform feature fusion for features at different spatial locations to enhance features coarse extraction of anomaly. Finally, the extracted high-dimensional feature embeddings are mapped to the latent space using normalized flow for distribution fitting, and the likelihood of anomaly existence is calculated using the latent distribution. As a result, our empirical study on the MVTec_AD dataset show that the detection accuracy of our method exceeds baselines, and our method has a faster inference speed. The ablation experiments also demonstrate the effectiveness of the multiscale feature propagation architecture, especially on enhancing the model's ability to detect tiny anomalies. In addition, our approach includes a faster inference speed and less space consumption.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design of Environment Map Construction for Inspection Robots Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Inspection robots are a hot research topic in the field of mobile robots, and the construction of environmental maps is a prerequisite for robot inspection. However, the existing LIDAR-based map building algorithms can cause inaccurate measurements due to distortion and dithering during operation. In this paper, a loosely coupled LiDAR-IMU fusion scheme is designed at the front which can processing the pre-integration information of the IMU, then the distortion of motion in the laser point cloud will be remove, thus, the alignment accuracy of two adjacent point clouds is improved. The back-end uses a tightly coupled fusion approach to obtain the positional information based on error-state Kalman filtering by jointly optimizing the residual terms of the IMU with the residual terms of the laser point cloud matched with the local map. The results are tested on the open-source dataset KITTI, and the environmental maps with better performance are obtained.

articleTitle: Implementation of LMS Algorithm Based Adaptive Filter Using Verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This article focuses on the deployment of minimum mean square algorithm filters on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). The principle and structure of the Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithm filters are briefly discussed. An improved and high-speed FPGA deployment method is proposed. The full pipelined structure of the LMS adaptive filter is implemented by adding a counter module to control the global structure of the entire algorithm. The basic modules for deploying the LMS algorithm adaptive filter, such as the counter, are given. Comprehensive simulations of the adaptive filter deployed in this way are carried out and compared with the original LMS algorithm filter. Results show that this proposed method could achieve high maximum frequency.

articleTitle: Study for Ultra-Long-Distance Remote Reproduction of Standard Time Based on Rubidium Atomic Clock
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The existing time synchronization system is mainly used for single-user customization, or multi-user low-precision, the demand for low-cost, high-precision, and multi user is increasing. To realize the high-precision reproduction and autonomous maintenance of standard time signals in ultra-long distance by multiple users, a dynamic reproduction method of standard time based on rubidium atomic clock has been researched in this paper. It uses the remote time comparison method based on continuous GPS common-vision proposed by the team of Ya Liu of NTCS to traces to the UTC(NTSC). By using the methods, it can reproduce 1PPS signal with deviation less than 5ns. At present, this method has been applied to standard time reproduction equipment and several time comparison systems.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Bessel Digital Low-Pass Filters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: IIR Filters have been utilized widely in the domain of signal processing. Among the existing kinds of IIR filters, the Bessel digital filters are linear filters with maximum flat group delay in the passband. Bessel filters are widely used in applications requiring high-quality signal reconstruction and precise control of frequency characteristics, which can effectively avoid signal phase distortion. This article introduces the design method of converting a Bessel analog filter to a Bessel digital low-pass filter using bilinear transformation method in detail. The transfer function of the filters is derived theoretically. Meanwhile, the characteristics of Bessel filters are evaluated by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Improved Multipole Moment Electrical Heater for Magnetic Field Self-Suppression Based on Discrete Currents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The atomic vapor cell is an important part of the atomic sensor. These cells usually need to be heated to a high temperature to increase the density of alkali-metal atoms, and electrical heaters are typically used for this purpose. Atomic magnetometer is very sensitive to the magnetic field, resulting in a higher demand for nonmagnetic electrical heating technology. This study proposes an improved multipole moment electrical heater configuration for magnetic field self-suppression based on discrete currents. Compared to the previous <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{N}$</tex> multipole moment configuration, this method not only considers the influence of the relative current direction, but also optimizes the current magnitude. First, a magnetic field analysis model of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{N}$</tex> multipole moment configuration was established, and a method of introducing the discrete current was proposed to improve the self-suppression effect of the magnetic field. Then, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the current magnitude parameters and structural dimensions to design an improved multipole moment configuration to improve the self-suppression effect. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified using finite element simulations. Compared with the previously developed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{N}$</tex> multipole moment configuration, the proposed heating configuration generates a magnetic field of 0.79 nT at the cell center point and an average magnetic field of 1.15 nT within the central region of the cell under the same heating power, thereby reducing the average magnetic field by approximately 33%.

articleTitle: Linux-Based Oscilloscope Kernel Driver Software Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper implements a PXI Express kernel driver that complies with the Interchangeable Virtual Instruments (IVI) specification based on the self-developed digital oscilloscope hardware and the Galaxy Kirin Linux operating system produced in China, which is compatible with both PCI and PCIe buses. The integrity of device connectivity and register access between the digital oscilloscope hardware module and software was verified through the user interface, and the driver is smooth to use and can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Miniaturized Unmanned Vehicle Tire Pressure Detection System Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To improve the safe driving performance of the car and reduce the risk of tire blowouts, this paper designs a miniaturized tire pressure detection system based on the MCU. Firstly, a direct tire pressure detection scheme is used to collect tire pressure and tire temperature data. Secondly, the hardware system mainly includes a data acquisition and transmission module, data reception and display module, a buzzer alarm module, etc. The MCU employs STM32F103 series chips, and the NRF24L01 radio frequency chip is used to realize wireless detection data transmission. Finally, the driver of the tire pressure and temperature detection module employs the successive comparison dichotomy method, which increases the efficiency of data collection. Experimental results show that the tire pressure detection system can realize the real-time detection and alarm function of the internal pressure and temperature of the tire, which can effectively prevent the car from puncturing, and further protect the life and property safety of drivers and passengers.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Channel Signal Switching Circuit for High-Resolution Thermocouple Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Thermocouple sensor is a common temperature sensor. It is cheap and has a wide range of temperature measurement. It is widely used in industrial production. Its supporting acquisition system needs multi-channel, high precision, high resolution and supports the requirements of a variety of thermocouple typos. Therefore, this paper focuses on solving the problem of multi-channel high-precision signal acquisition and switching, and realizes a high-precision thermocouple acquisition and switching hardware architecture with 48 channels, output data rate of 1ksps/channel, temperature measurement range of -200~1820 °C, temperature accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 0.25^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> and resolution of 0.1 °C.

articleTitle: Design of Thunder Imaging System and Observation for Ground and Intracloud Lightning Flashes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: a sensitive acoustic sensor used to detect audible sound from lightning discharge is specially designed. The sensor employs a field-effect transistor circuit as preamplifier and a linear operation amplification for signal enhancement. A thunder imaging system is established, including acoustic sensor array, data acquisition system, and corresponding acquisition and analysis software. The system was used to observe thunder signal and lightning 3D structure in the JiangSu Province in the summer of 2016. The observation results indicate that the system can depict the three-dimensional discharge channels of lightning, and reveal the acoustic characteristics of different discharge channels in both time and frequency domain. The thunder sources are coincide with return stroke channel indicated by VHF results. The observation proves that thunder from ground flash is much stronger than cloud flash, with broader frequency band and larger pulse. The thunder sources are dominated in the vertical section in cloud flashes, which indicates that the vertical channel of cloud flash has a stronger current.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Thermal Measurement Technology Based on CCD Thermoreflectance Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of semiconductor manufacturing technology, miniaturization and multi-function have become the trend of semiconductor devices. The scaling of device features results in a significant reduction in time response, a high heat flux significantly, and an increased sensitivity to transient events. According to the reliability theory of semiconductor devices, there is a very close relationship between the operating temperature and performance and reliability of the device. Therefore, how to comprehensively characterize the transient thermal process of the device has become a major challenge. As a new type of non-contact thermal measurement technology, thermal measurement technology based on CCD thermoreflectance method can be used for thermal measurement of laser, photoelectric device, high-speed logic IC, MEMS sensor, LED, power electronic device and other semiconductor devices. However, in the process of transient measurement, due to the limitation of the frame rate of the CCD camera, the time resolution cannot reach the microsecond level, while the response time of most high-speed semiconductor devices are below the microsecond level. In this paper, the transient thermal measurement technology based on hardware timing sequence control is adopted to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Modulated Signal Open-Set Identification of Complex Convolutional Neural Networks Combined with Incremental Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper proposes a modulated signal open set recognition model based on CVCNN (Complex Value Convolutional Neural Network) combined with incremental learning to address the limitations of traditional modulated signal open set recognition in distinguishing unknown classes. The study utilized CVCNN as a feature extractor to extract semantic features of samples and identify unknown signals based on the distance center measure between the semantic signals. The findings indicate that the CVCNN model can accurately identify trained samples, reject untrained unknown classes, and distinguish between different unknown classes. Additionally, the complex convolutional neural network proposed in this study is well-suited for feature extraction and recognition of IQ (Inphase and quadrature) signals.

articleTitle: A Flexible Wave Velocity Measurement Method Applied to Low Pressure Load Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A flexible wave velocity measurement method is proposed and a flexible velocity sensor specimen based on the tiny beam structure is manufactured by flexible processing technology. Different from commercial flexible displacement sensor and other traditional wave velocity sensors, the proposed flexible sensor is devoted to achieving faster response time and smaller pressure threshold. Theoretical analysis and primary experiment are carried out and preliminarily prove that the proposed flexible sensor can respond to the transonic sweeping low-pressure wave formed by aero shock tube in a few micro-seconds. Influence of the sensor interface is also qualitatively analyzed by actual time-domain curves and transonic fluid mechanical model, for better sensor interface technology.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Maintenance Decision for Flexible Electronic Manufacturing Equipment Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to achieve the intelligent maintenance of flexible electronic manufacturing equipment, this paper constructs an intelligent maintenance decision model based on deep reinforcement learning by combining a lifetime prediction network and Markov decision process. First, the life prediction network extracts a feature map characterizing the operating state of the equipment based on the raw data input from the equipment; the intelligent decision network then takes the feature map as an environmental input and uses the agent in the network to output maintenance actions for the equipment; finally, through the continuous iterative update of the life prediction network and the intelligent decision network, the decision model can continuously optimize the maintenance decision of the equipment, thus assisting the equipment to complete the maintenance decision task. Experiments on the bearing dataset show that the proposed model can effectively implement intelligent maintenance decision for the equipment.

articleTitle: Debris Material Identification Based on EMD - SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Different mechanical parts are often made of different metal materials, and obtaining information about the abrasive grain material can help to realize accurate positioning of the wear location. However, a weak point in oil monitoring has always been the distinct identification of abrasive particle material. As a result, a unique method based on EMD and SVM is proposed for the differentiation of metal materials. Through simulation and theoretical analysis, it is proven that metal particles of different materials have different signal characteristics due to their different electrical and magnetic conductivities. The approach described in this study can achieve precise differentiation of six distinct kinds of metal abrasive particle materials with an accuracy rate as high as 95.8% and has a high efficiency and steady performance, according to trials with various algorithmic models. For the evaluation of equipment's health and the diagnosis of faults, this study is extremely important.

articleTitle: Methodology for Jitter Analysis in Digital Storage Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As data rates consistently increase, timing margins in high-speed digital circuits are decreasing dramatically, and signal integrity (SI) is severely challenged by jitter. Jitter analysis has become an effective means of assessing SI and plays a role in high-speed system design. With the development of digital storage oscilloscope (DSO), increasing waveform storage depth provides sufficient raw data for jitter analysis, making jitter analysis a necessary function of high-end DSO. This paper focuses on the methodology for jitter analysis and its implementation in DSO. Comparison experiments with other commercial oscilloscopes show that the jitter analysis methodology presented in this paper exhibits high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Water Meter Based on Non Magnetic Sensor and NB-IoT Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: At present, the water consumption collection technology of intelligent water meters mainly includes pulse counting [1]–[3], photoelectric direct reading [4]–[6], photo recognition reading [7]–[9], etc. Currently, most pulse counting techniques use magnetoresistive sensors, but these sensors are susceptible to strong magnetic attacks. There are also various issues with photoelectric direct reading technology and photo recognition readings. Therefore, it is necessary to adopt methods to overcome these shortcomings to meet the system requirements. This article sets up a rotary table in the gear system of the water meter. PCB is used to make two perpendicular excitation coils and then symmetrically make two induction coils within the two excitation coils. When the turntable rotates, the two excitation coils periodically rotate to generate excitation electromagnetic fields. As the rotary table rotates, the comparator will periodically output a pulse, count the pulses, and then obtain the water consumption of the water meter. The rotation direction of the water meter can also be obtained by comparing the phase of the output pulses of two comparators in two vertical excitation coils. According to the water consumption reading data of the water meter under long-term operation under strong magnetic interference, the water consumption reading error meets the system requirements. At the same time, valve control technology, button and indicator technology, low power electronic technology and new communication technology - NB-IOT [10]–[15] are integrated, which can realize remote communication, Automatic meter reading and prepaid functions and realize intelligent water meters. In the end, the actual products were developed and applied in batches in the market, receiving high praise from users.

articleTitle: A Study of Passive Positioning Performance of Commercial Spectrum Monitoring Satellites Based on Frequency Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the growth of global trade activities, the effective regulation of marine illegal acts has become a difficult problem to be solved urgently, and the radio frequency use behavior of ships provides conditions for monitoring their positioning. This paper summarizes the development status of spectrum monitoring satellites at home and abroad, and analyzes the basic principles of spectrum detection satellites. Taking HawkEye 360, the world's leading spectrum detection satellite, as the research object, in the possibility of passive positioning using only frequency measurements. The performance of rough localization is analyzed based on the Doppler residual surface intersection method, which can provide a reference for the initial value selection of the iterative algorithm.

articleTitle: Weak Signal Detection Method Under Lévy Noise Based on Duffing Chaotic System and Fast Phase Judgment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As modern scientific instrument technology improves by leaps and bounds, the noise reduction technology of underwater vehicle is constantly improved. The signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) received by the underwater acoustic collection system in complex marine noise environments is decreasing. Since the 1960s, the noise level of submarines has been reduced by 36dB. Traditional spectrum estimation and wavelet analysis methods are no longer able to meet the requirements. The Duffing chaotic oscillator(DCO) method has low SNR detection threshold and is insensitive to noise, making it suitable for underwater target detection with complex noise signals. However, existing DCO methods have complex system phase determination methods and are mostly validated using Gaussian noise. This paper presents a method based on FFT to quickly determine the phase state of DCO under the condition of weak single frequency signal. By using Lévy noise to simulate underwater noise background, the detection SNR can reach -15.7dB. Theoretically, the phase state determination can be completed in as fast as 35 seconds. In the case of large data volume, it has great engineering application advantages.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Ultra-Small Optical Fiber Spectrometer in Multi-Parameter Water Quality Online Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-small optical fiber spectrometer with wide bandwidth and high resolution is developed based on the asymmetrical cross Czerny-Turner system, the volume of the spectrometer is only palm size, which greatly saves the installation space and improves the measurement accuracy. This optical fiber spectrometer was applied as a beam splitting system in a multi-parameter water quality online analyzer developed by our company, and the performance of the analytical instrument is tested according to the national metrological verification regulations and environmental protection industry standards. The experimental results show that the optical fiber spectrometer can meet the application requirements of the multi-parameter water quality online analyzer, with high measurement accuracy, which effectively improves the timeliness and accuracy of water quality monitoring, and provides the strong technical support for the construction of water quality safety monitoring. The ultra small design also provides feasibility for the design of compact and portable multi-parameter water quality online analyzers, which is of great significance for the iterative upgrade of water quality analysis instruments.

articleTitle: Finite Element Design of Biomolecular Sensor Chip Based on QCM/LSPR Dual Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Biomolecular sensor chips can realize real-time monitoring of biomolecular mass, promote the research and development of biomolecules, and have important research value.In this paper, a dual technology sensing detection method combining QCM/LSPR is proposed. Through the simulation analysis of the finite element analysis software COMSOL Multiphysics, the reasonable structure and parameters of the chip are obtained.It was found that the arrangement structure of gold nanorod dimer greatly affected the LSPR of nanorods, and then affected the detection results of biomolecules.Compared with the parallel arrangement of gold nanorods, the resonance peak value of longitudinal arrangement is larger, and the electromagnetic field acts more directly on the space near the connection point, which can enhance the local electric field strength.In addition, in terms of chip oscillation performance, the simulation found that the series capacitor between the oscillator and the voltage source will increase the resonant frequency. Different series capacitors correspond to different resonant frequencies. The resonant frequencies at different points of the same chip are basically the same but the amplitudes are different. On this basis, through simulation analysis of QCM mass sensitivity distribution, it is concluded that compared with the polar structure, the non-polar structure used to assemble the gold nanorod has a higher particle displacement amplitude in the central area of the ring gold electrode, and the mass sensitivity is doubled, which is conducive to the improvement of the plasma resonance characteristics of the gold nanorod. We integrate chips of two technologies, complement each other's advantages, overcome the lack of detection of a single technology, and have broad prospects in biomolecular research.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Bearings Based on Multi-Feature Fusion of CWT-2D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the issue of fault recognition, in order to achieve a higher matching rate between samples and labels, it is necessary to be able to extract richer fault feature information. Therefore, a CWT-2D-CNN bearing fault intelligent diagnosis method is proposed. Firstly, the one-dimensional vibration signal collected is transformed by CWT to construct a two-dimensional image with rich time-frequency information, which is used as the input of the 2D-CNN network, enabling the network to learn as much as possible about the fault time-frequency feature information. Secondly, through deep convolutional pooling layers, further dimensionality reduction of the results from the previous step is a necessary step, which can reduce the difficulty and parameters of optimization and further reduce information redundancy. In the last, the network structure is optimized through backpropagation algorithm to construct an integrated framework model from the extracting feature, decreasing dimensionality to classifying of fault signal. Through fault classification experiments under different states, the model achieves an identification accuracy of 97.98% for faults and can accurately discriminate fault states, verifying the effectiveness of the method, which can serve as one of the inspiration sources for future intelligent diagnosis directions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Metrology and Data Management of Satellite Specialized Comprehensive Test System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Satellite is a complex and sophisticated functional entity. Because of this feature, result of satellite functions and performance test depends on the precision of indicators, test accuracy and other inherent characteristics of ground test systems. As specialized equipment for satellite comprehensive test, the ground test system is a functional combination composed of multiple sets of equipment and their accessories, integrated according to certain constraints. In response to this characteristic, this article proposes an integrated metrology method and data analysis management method based on the satellite comprehensive test system. From system design to metrological data analysis, the entire process is tracked to provide support for satellite test.

articleTitle: Research on Soft x-Ray Polarimetry Based on Bragg Diffraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The detection of space polarization X-rays is an important scientific research topic in the 21st century. In order to meet the ground calibration requirements of polarized X-ray detectors, a polarized X-ray source is required. Based on the energy range and requirements of existing mainstream polarimetric X-ray detectors, a Bragg diffraction-based soft X-ray polarimeter has been designed. It is used to generate X-ray polarization and to measure the polarization and polarization angle of X-rays. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{LiF}420$</tex> was used as the diffraction crystal for the experiments and a polarization degree of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$75.1 \pm 1.2{\%}$</tex> was obtained. We believe that this result can be further optimized and that changing to another crystal may give better results.

articleTitle: Modeling of RF Multiport Circuit Based on X-parameter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The nonlinear modeling of multi-port devices plays a crucial role in complex RF systems. Because the multi-port module can be regarded as a basic unit similar to the system, it needs to be accurately characterized by large signal nonlinearity when modeling and analyzing the system. This article mainly introduces the importance of using modeling methods to accurately and conveniently analyze the performance indicators of nonlinear devices in complex RF systems. The X-parameters can describe the characteristics of harmonic frequency terms for nonlinear devices under any linear network and large signal operating conditions, and has stronger model universality and flexibility compared to the S parameter. This article also conducts behavior level modeling method and simulation verification by selecting typical mixer cascade and mixer amplifier cascade in the RF system structure, proving that the output results of the X-parameters model are still accurate when used in cascaded situations. This method can be used by RF designers to design products more quickly and reduce the number of prototypes that need to be manufactured and tested, predicting RF System output results, accelerating the product development cycle.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Error Calibration Methods for HMP155 Humidity Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the requirements of Guangdong Meteorological Station for HMP155 humidity sensor, this paper summarizes the laboratory calibration experience, and obtains three calibration methods of the sensor under the condition of common indication value error. According to the single point deviation, linear fitting and high humidity increased density, the indication error of the sensor is effectively reduced by means of key adjustment and serial port commands input. The adjusted sensor calibration data meet the needs of the regulations and the observation requirements.

articleTitle: Disturbance Analysis and Solution in High Precision Magnetic Torquer Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: High-precision magnetic torquer is the core actuator of satellite attitude control, and its ground test effect and control accuracy are very important to satellite attitude control. In this paper, a magnetic torquer with 2‰ resolution and better than 1% output accuracy is designed for a satellite, and the disturbance problem in the test is analyzed, and it is found that the system stability problem is brought while the accuracy is improved. The generation mechanism is that the main compensation parameters are close to the bias signal, and the main device parameters are greatly affected by temperature, which leads to the system instability under high temperature conditions and affects the reliability of the product. A solution to the disturbance problem has been proposed for this phenomenon, that is, by adjusting the hardware structure of the driving circuit and the current sampling method, the system stability problem is solved efficiently, and the accurate and reliable operation of the satellite attitude control is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Denoising for Coal-Gangue Impacting the Tail Beam of Hydraulic Support Based on Improved ALO and VMD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aim to the problem that the signal contains background noise when using the vibration signal of the coal-gangue impacting the tail beam of hydraulic support for coal-gangue mixed ratio identification, a noise reduction method based on the combination of improved ant-lion optimizer (ALO), variational modulus decomposition (VMD), mutual information (MI) and multiscale permutation entropy (MPE) is proposed. Firstly, an improved ALO algorithm is designed by using the chaos search strategy (CSALO) to achieve the optimization of the key parameters of VMD (VMD-CSALO). Secondly, the vibration signals of the coal-gangue impacting the tail beam of hydraulic support are decomposed by the VMD-CSALO. Finally, the denoised vibration signals are reconstructed according to MI and MPE. Then, to verify the reliability and superiority of the denoising by VMD-CSALO, a simulated experimental platform of mixed coal-gangue caving was built. Through experimental comparison with wavelet transform (WT), VMD-WT and complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD)-WT methods, the results show that this paper can remove the noise more effectively, and the coal-gangue mixed ratio identification accuracy of the signal processed by this paper is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method of Beam Shaping Based on Ultra High Sensitivity Magnetic Field Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This article proposes a beam shaping optimization method based on ultra-high sensitivity magnetic field measurement, which is used to optimize the ultra-high sensitivity magnetic field measurement device for atomic spin effect. Based on the structure and working principle of an ultra-high sensitivity, as well as the laser beam covering the sensitive element alkali metal gas chamber of the entire device, it is inferred that a uniform beam has certain research significance for the sensitivity of magnetic field measurement devices. Analysis of ultra-high sensitivity magnetic field measurement devices based on atomic spin effect, sensitivity experiments were conducted. At a frequency of 30 Hz, the sensitivity of the magnetic field device without beam optimization was 30.12 fT/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>, while the sensitivity of the magnetic field device with beam optimization was 17.82 fT/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>. A comprehensive analysis of the experimental results shows that the method based on phase modulated uniform beam has certain research significance for the sensitivity of the device.

articleTitle: Research on Servo Control Chip of CPT Atomic Clock
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: CPT atomic clock has the advantages of low power consumption and small size, which can provide high precision and miniaturized frequency standard for such as GNSS receiver, time-frequency system node, underwater navigation and other application. This paper presents a design method of system packaging of special servo control circuit for CPT atomic clock, which can achieve the maximum power reduction and lightweight of the servo control circuit, so as to further reduce the power consumption and volume of the CPT atomic clock alarm. In this paper, self-developed chip size is realized <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$12.00\text{mm}(\text{length})\times 12.00\text{mm}(\text{width})\times$</tex> 1.60mm(thickness), power consumption 120mW. The chip servo control function is stable and reliable, which core components from all dependence on import to domestic nearly 80%, that has important significance for expanding the application range of CPT atomic clock.

Author Keywords: reduce the power consumption and volume

articleTitle: Research on Active Disturbances Rejection Control Strategy of Water-Lubricated Bearing Lubrication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Lubrication system for water-lubricated bearing to provide a stable water supply pressure and flow, its stability is vital to the formation of water film and stable operation of the bearing; however, the general water-lubricated bearing lubrication system also has a large time lag, multiple coupling, weak anti-interference ability and other deficiencies. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a self-turbulence control strategy, i.e., the active disturbances rejection controller (ADRC) is used to control the lubrication system water supply pressure and then regulate the system water supply flow. The introduction of a water-lubricated bearing and lubrication system control strategy, coupled with the design of an expansion state observer (ESO) to estimate system and external disturbance based on the mapping relationship between solenoid regulating valve opening and water supply pressure, is the first step. The estimated total disturbance is used to construct an active disturbances rejection controller; then, the active disturbances rejection control algorithm is studied and a mathematical and simulation model is established; finally, a simulation test is conducted to compare with the PID control effect. The results demonstrate that the control strategy and system have been successful in managing sudden pressure alterations, thus enhancing the lubrication system's accuracy, response speed, and robustness. The step response time of the lubrication system is improved by 25.29% relative to the PID control method, and the overshoot is decreased by 4.47%.

articleTitle: Multivariate Estimation of Cardiac Output Using Photoplethysmography
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The paper introduce a novel technique for continuous monitoring of cardiac output by mathematical analysis of 8 morphological features from the descending aorta's photoplethysmographic (PPG) signal. To validate the feasibility of the technique, PPG waveforms were captured from 7 animal experiments to compare with CO from conventional PICCO monitor. A Gaussian Process Regression model was employed to fit PPG data, and k-fold cross-validation (k=5) was performed for evaluation. Notably, a strong correlation was observed between the regression model and the PICCO method, with R2 ranging from 0.86 to 0.98. Furthermore, the Bland-Altman analysis confirmed the close agreement between the estimates from our regression model and the PICCO measurements, and exhibited a mean deviation of 0.0008 L/min and a standard deviation of 0.161 L/min.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Method for Time Series Networks Based on ARIMA-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The increasing scale of network access in recent years requires an advanced analysis of future network data traffic(NDT) trends to anticipate various network scenarios. However, current prediction methods are limited in accuracy due to the overly complex components of network traffic on the time scale. This paper proposes a time series network traffic prediction(NTP) method based on the ARIMA-LSTM model. The method uses the ARIMA to extract the linear components of the web traffic data and then uses the LSTM to extract the nonlinear components further. It will achieve effective prediction of complex time series. The article validates the effectiveness of the method experimentally on two publicly available datasets. All experimental results show that the ARIMA-LSTM method has satisfactory prediction performance and outperforms several other state-of-the-art works. In sum, this NTP method points to a new orientation for NDT monitoring and analysis.

articleTitle: Study for Power Delay Profile Validation of Channel Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The Power Delay Profile of channel model need to be tested and validated. First, the basic method and principle of Power Delay Profile validation is analyzed and described; Then a solution is brought out for the issue of two paths aliasing, and the solution is tested and practised with a channel emulator (Spirent Vertex) and a vector network analyzer(Rohde&Schwarz ZNB8). It can be concluded that: 1)Power Delay Profile should be enabled separately with Doppler Effect, cross polarization, spatial correlation, etc.; 2) the frequency scanning points of the vector network analyzer should follow the principle of ‘more than less’ and the scanning bandwidth should be set as large as possible to reduce aliasing and improve delay accuracy; 3)furthermore, in order to separate aliasing paths, an indirect validation method can be performed by enabling each aliasing paths separately.

articleTitle: A Stigmergic Optimization Method for Distributed Collaboration in Satellite Swarm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Distributed collaboration for satellite swarm has good robustness, parallelism, and execution capability, but its performance is still somehow limited. How to reduce the reliance of distributed collaboration on a large amount of information interaction and computational support becomes a difficult point to constrain the collaboration of a satellite swarm. Stigmergy is a bionic-based distributed general collaboration mechanism in swarm intelligence, which can effectively improve the communication efficiency and break the bottleneck of communication of swarm system. In this paper, based on the stigmergy mechanism, an implicit communication method containing multiple semantic information for satellite swarm is established. Meanwhile, based on the implicit communication method, a satellite swarm collaboration mechanism (SSCM) is proposed. Finally, a satellite swarm collaborative task scenario is simulated based on SSCM. In a discrete grid map, multiple satellites collaborate in a distributed manner via digital pheromones for the “detection-imaging” task chain. The simulation results show that SSCM performs well in task execution rate and target coverage, with improvements of up to 30.8% and 44% compared to others. The simulation experiments validate the robustness and applicability of SSCM, and the experiment has some scalability in problem scale.

articleTitle: Research on Application Development of Ultrasonic Data Acquisition System for Rail Flaw Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper describes the overall development and design of an embedded ultrasonic flaw detection system for rail flaw detection and management. Firstly, the principle and hardware framework of embedded ultrasonic detection is introduced. Subsequently, the development method and design of WDF-based USB driver and dynamic link library is explained. In the process of dynamic link library development, a new combined method of asynchronous IO operation, multi-threaded design, and multi-device sliding asynchronous operation is proposed. Finally, the modules of host computer GUI, the playback of waveform video, and the development and design process of DAC/AVG curve drawing module are introduced. The new developed flaw detection and management system is applied to metro track safety monitoring and health management effectively.

articleTitle: Error Experiment of 600-2000A/ 5A Current Transformer Based on Improved Core Material
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For adapting to the measurement of wide range current and avoid economic losses in the power grid, this paper first uses improved iron core materials to manufacture a new electromagnetic current transformer. The external dimensions of the new current transformer have not changed compared to ordinary transformers, but the iron core material is different. Then, in order to verify whether the error of the new CT meets the requirements, and to verify the error consistency of the prototype, this paper made 10 transformer prototypes with different primary current ratings. Finally, this paper designed and produced a prototype error testing platform, which can simultaneously test the errors of 10 transformers. The test results show that the error of the transformer using the new core material meets the accuracy requirement of 0.2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{s}$</tex> and has good consistency. Therefore, this new transformer can be called a wide-range electromagnetic CT.

articleTitle: Research on Delay Calibration Method of Software Receiver Based on RF Direct Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: High precision timing receivers play an important role in time and frequency transmission. Device delay calibration is an important component of receiver calibration traceability. In response to the existing problem of time domain flip point method for measuring device delay calibration, this paper proposes a software receiver delay calibration method based on RF direct sampling, achieving high-precision absolute device delay calibration of BOC and QPSK modulated signals output by the Beidou (GNSS) simulator. This method solves the delay calibration problem of the GNSS simulator equipment, and based on this, utilizing delay transmission can achieve receiver device delay calibration.

articleTitle: A Dedicated Memory Testing Processor Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a new dedicated processor design for Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) in Automatic Test Equipment (ATE). Instead of supporting only limited memory test algorithm, this paper proposes a dedicated processor which can process the instructions and generating variable memory test patterns in sequence. Both test patterns and pin mapping relationship are programmable, and can be easily adapted to a wide range of different topologic configurations of the memory array. The new designed instruction sets enable multiple Pattern Generators (PG) implemented inside the dedicated processors to work simultaneously and to generate test patterns up to 3.2Gbps automatically in line with microcode which test engineers have designed. This paper will describe in detail about the dedicated processor design and show the experiment results about flexible test patterns generation by microcode at high speed.

articleTitle: Underwater Multi-Parameter Magnetic Anomaly Detection System Carried by Autonomous Underwater Vehicle and Its Data Preprocessing Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) equipped with towed magnetic anomaly detection (MAD) system is a reliable underwater magnetic target detection technology. Using the detected magnetic anomaly information, the position and magnetic moment of the magnetic target can be estimated. In this paper, an underwater multi-parameter magnetic anomaly detection system equipped with scalar and vector magnetometers is proposed. Two scalar magnetometers are deployed in the horizontal direction, and the vector magnetometers are deployed behind their vertical lines. The system can synchronously collect scalar and vector magnetic anomaly data generated by magnetic targets, as well as horizontal gradient magnetic anomaly data. After preprocessing such as carrier magnetic interference compensation, coordinate system conversion and data denoising, the detection and location of magnetic targets can be realized. As an extension, multiple systems can form a detection network through cluster cooperative detection, which provides a new idea for deep-sea long-distance and fast detection of magnetic targets. Finally, the practicability of the system is verified by field experiment.

articleTitle: Attention-Based Transformer Thermal Infrared Tracker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The CNN-based tracker achieves excellent performance, but there are few researches on tracking TIRsingle target. TIR images have blurred outlines, lack color and texture information, so it is difficult to extract strong feature information and distinguish interference when using an RGB tracker to directly track TIR targets, which will lead to poor tracking robustness. We suggest a TIR tracker based on a Siamese tracker and a Transformer to address these issues. Specifically, we improved a feature extraction network with channel attention. Based on Transformer, we propose submodules named CA. We use Transformer as a matching module between the feature map of the template and the search region. The CA module realizes the mutual enhancement of the two path information, finds the feature dependence of the template and the search region, which provides rich context information. And we used the LSOTB-TIR evaluation dataset to verify its performance, which results that our tracker having advanced performance.

articleTitle: Static and Dynamic Key Error Modeling for High-Speed Segmented Current Steering Digital-to-Analog Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: High-speed and high-precision digital-to-analog converter (DAC) has significant application value in various fields, including communication, test and measurement instruments and radar. The segmented current steering DAC has gained widespread attention due to its high-speed and high-precision characteristics. However, the current fabrication processes still have room for improvement in terms of the spurious-free dynamic range and other characteristics of the DAC. In order to address this, this article introduces a modeling method for the error model of the segmented current steering DAC. Three models are developed in this study, which include the ideal segmented current steering DAC model, the current source mismatch error model, and the finite output impedance error model. Additionally, a novel method using RC filtering is introduced to model the clock feedthrough error for the first time. The proposed models are further analyzed to examine their effectiveness and accuracy in capturing the static and dynamic characteristics.

Author Keywords: the current source mismatch error model
the finite output impedance error model

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Method for Meter Instance Segmentation Under Data Balancing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of smart grids, the methods of using cameras or robots for image acquisition and recognition of meters are gradually replacing traditional manual inspections. To enable more efficient meter recognition by deep learning models, the quality of training data is of paramount importance, with data imbalance being a major challenge in rough data. We propose a data augmentation method for meter instance segmentation under a data balancing strategy, called meter balanced object paste (MeterBOP), which pastes meter objects into images of different scenes according to predefined rules, thereby optimizing the data distribution. The approach selects the pasting meter types by class-balanced sampling and scales them to various sizes for scale balance. The pasting regions are generated according to the distribution of existing objects in the image, thus achieving spatial balance while avoiding severe occlusion caused by introducing new objects. Experiments demonstrate that our method improves the performance of Mask R-CNN by 3.1 Box mAP and 1.0 Mask mAP on power meter image-mask (PMI-M) dataset. Furthermore, the method can provide stable performance improvements under various detectors and conditions, exhibiting superior performance enhancement compared to other data augmentation methods.

articleTitle: Design of Multifunctional Built-in Test System for Communication Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the needs of fast, timely and low complexity field test and maintenance of modern communication equipment, this paper designs a multifunctional communication equipment built-in test (BIT) system, and gives a detailed software and hardware design scheme. The system can quickly test and diagnose the RF, IF and LF modules in the communication equipment. The verification results show that the functional modules of the system can stably obtain the status data, and display the test data and diagnosis results in multiple styles, which meets the system design requirements. The system architecture can also provide reference for the research, design and implementation of built-in test technology for other equipment.

articleTitle: Pulse-Width Trigger Method in 10GSPS Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In linear FM signal detection applications such as communications and radar, the pulse width of the signal can vary by hundreds of picoseconds, requiring the acquisition system to have higher acquisition performance and trigger performance to acquire and capture signals with small variations in pulse width. As one of the advanced trigger functions of a data acquisition system, pulse-width trigger has the ability to detect the pulse width of the input signal in real time and control the acquisition process in order to capture the signal that meets the conditions of pulse-width trigger. With the increasing frequency of the signal, the high-speed acquisition system is required not only to have the ability to capture small changes in the signal pulse width, but also to have a higher ability to detect the minimum pulse width. In high-speed acquisition systems, the traditional pulse-width trigger is realized by the analog pulse-width trigger. The analog pulse-width trigger has the advantage of real-time, but it also has the problem of large trigger jitter and low trigger accuracy due to the non-linear lead of the high-speed analog device and the analog-digital synchronization. This paper proposes a high-precision digital pulse-width trigger method. The method adopts the design of synchronizing the sampling data with the trigger data source, which solves the problem of trigger jitter in analog pulse-width trigger. The digital pulse-width trigger uses a method of converting high-speed parallel sampling data into parallel feature data that can characterize the edge features of the pulse signal. Then, according to the characteristics of the starting edge and the ending edge of the pulse width, the pulse width of the pulse signal is calculated. Finally, the pulse width trigger judgment is performed, and the trigger point position is obtained in real time to achieve the high-precision pulse width trigger. The method is implemented in a 10GSPS data acquisition system using an ADC+FPGA architecture. After testing, the minimum detectable pulse width of the digital pulse-width trigger is 200ps, and the pulse-width trigger jitter is less than 100ps.

articleTitle: Inertial Navigation Trajectory and Attitude Prediction Based on Improved Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the trajectory prediction time of inertial navigation system (INS) data is too long and the attitude cannot be predicted, a trajectory and attitude prediction method of Improved Hidden Markov model (IHMM) is proposed. This method improves the conventional HMM, and uses Gaussian weighted-average moving filter to preprocess the data and eliminate the background noise. To solve the parameters more accurately, the Baum-Welch algorithm and maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) method is introduced. The Viterbi algorithm is improved by adding nonlinear transition probability function for decoding and prediction. Through experiments, the performance of IHMM is verified, the simulation and measured data are used for prediction, and the prediction accuracy of X, Y and Z axis acceleration data are 0.85, 0.85 and 0.95 respectively. Moreover, the comparison between IHMM and recurrent neural network (RNN) are also compared. The result shows that, within the range of acceptable prediction accuracy, the running time of the IHMM is about one-third that of RNN. Finally, this method can predict the trajectory and attitude of the vehicle, and provide effective information for environment recognition and prediction in scenarios with strong real-time performance.

articleTitle: Estimation of Time Base Distortion of High Speed Sampling Oscilloscope Based on Trust-Region Reflection Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on the concept and mechanism of time base distortion, this paper focuses on a trust-region reflection least squares algorithm for estimating time base distortion. The method is to estimate the time base distortion of oscilloscope by using multi-frequency and multi-phase signals. In this paper, the third harmonic model and the average method of 20 groups of 4 waveforms are used, and the experimental verification is carried out. The results show that the trust-region reflection least square method is correct and effective to estimate the time base distortion.

articleTitle: Order Analysis Algorithm Based on Time-Domain Stretching and Its Logic Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To address the spectrum aliasing caused by the non-uniform and non-stationary characteristics of rotating machinery vibration signals in the field of dynamic signal analysis, this paper proposes a time-domain stretching based order analysis algorithm. This algorithm stretches the vibration signal in the time domain, which facilitates the frequency domain compression caused by the signal stretching in the time domain to reduce the frequency domain aliasing caused by the spectrum broadening caused by the characteristics of the vibration signal. At the same time, in order to deal with the unequal interval sampling caused by the signal stretching in time domain, this paper integrates the resampling principle of cubic spline interpolation into the algorithm, which improves the accuracy of order analysis. In addition, the implementation of this algorithm in Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is described in detail. At the same time, this paper also uses simulation experiments to test each module inside the algorithm, and analyzes the accuracy of important steps such as cubic spline interpolation, which verifies the feasibility of the actual system.

articleTitle: Relative Humidity Detection Method of Air-tight Storage Box for Weapon Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The detection of relative humidity can ensure the stability of tactical and technical indexes of weapon equipment and the effective operation of combat missions. Traditional relative humidity detection methods include color card indicating method, mechanical indicating method and electronic sensor acquisition method, but they cannot be uniformly converted into the relative humidity under standard temperature, which causes obstacles to the interpretation of data eligibility. In order to achieve uniform standard temperature conversion of relative humidity in air-tight environment, a relative humidity conversion algorithm based on enthalpy and humidity model was proposed. According to the ideal gas balance equation under air-tight conditions, the algorithm was derived by using model conversion method and data fitting method. An environmental parameter equipment implanted with the algorithm was developed to convert and display, so as to achive relative humidity output under standard temperature. Calibration experiment results review that the temperature measurement uncertainty was 0.2 °C <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{k}=2)$</tex>, the relative humidity measurement uncertainty was 2.0% RH <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{k}=2)$</tex>, and the absolute pressure measurement uncertainty was 0.05kPa <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{k}=2)$</tex>. The accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm for relative humidity detection at standard temperature are verified by comparative experiments at different temperatures.

articleTitle: Review of Weak Signals Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In engineering application, the weak signals generated by the system during operation are useful in determining the working status of the system. But such effective signals are usually masked by strong noise, making it difficult to extract useful information. Therefore, it is particularly important to study weak signal detection technology. This article introduces some weak signal detection methods including linear method and nonlinear method. Linear detection methods can be generally divided into time domain analysis, frequency domain analysis and Time-Frequency analysis. Nonlinear method includes Chaos theory, Stochastic resonance method, differential oscillator and adaptive decomposition, which are the main nonlinear detection methods for weak signals. Then, this article analyzes the application scope, advantages, and disadvantages of these weak signal detection methods and summarized for future prospects.

articleTitle: PSO-Based Volterra Tensor Network for Predicting Short Circuit Degradation of p-GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In recent years, p-GaN high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) have become the most promising devices of the third-generation semiconductors for its excellent performance. However, the reliability problems of p-GaN HEMTs under repetitive short circuit stresses are significant issues for both researchers and engineers working on electronic science and technology. Due to the lack of sufficient knowledges, it is difficult to build physic-of-failure (PoF) solutions to predict the degradation processes. Nevertheless, existed measurement procedures can collect enough information of the degradation process of the devices. Hence, data-driven (DD) techniques are promising tools to monitor the degradation states of p-GaN HEMTs. However, state-of-art DD methods cannot depict the relationship of high-dimension features under the degradation processes. To overcome the weakness, we proposed a prediction model called PSO-based Volterra tensor network (PSO- VTN). The proposed model builds tensor network respect to a Volterra system and take PSO algorithms to optimize the corresponding parameters. Experiments show that PSO-VTN can successfully predict the output performance and transfer performance of the target devices with the historical data and provide support information for reliability decisions.

articleTitle: Indirect Testing of Specifications in Analog Integrated Circuits Based on Black-Box Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Conventional testing method of post-manufactures analog integrated circuits (ICs) is mainly relied on expensive automatic test equipment (ATE), which measure the specifications that included in the datasheet according to customized testing circuits and stimulus. In this paper, we proposed an indirect testing method based on modeling the mapping relationship between specifications and responses of much simpler circuits as black box. The model with good fitting ability could map the responses to specifications. Taking results obtained by standard approach as references, we verified the accuracy and effectiveness of this kind of indirect method by simulation experiments, the results shows that all errors of selected specifications obtained by standard and indirect method test are maintained in an acceptable level for post-manufacture testing.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: UAV Anomaly Detection Using Fleet Data Based on DBSCAN-MSET Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been widely applied in multiple fields for their convenience, low cost, and powerful function. Compared with single-UAV data, the UAV fleet data has more rich features, which can provide greater data collection and rich data information support to achieve more accurate anomaly detection. However, the flight paths of different UAVs vary greatly, which brings many challenges to fleet-level data analysis. And it is difficult for UAV fleet data to get exception labels to accurately build an anomaly detection model. Based on the above problems, this paper presents an anomaly detection method based on multivariate state estimation (MSET) and density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) optimization (DBSCAN- MSET). Establishing a normal state representation model from historical UAV data can effectively detect whether the following flight is abnormal. The proposed method is validated against the actual UAV data, and the results show the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Resource Scheduling Method for Satellites Combining Particle Swarm Optimization and Heuristic Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Satellites are crucial in meteorological remote sensing, national defence, and economic development. However, resources on satellites are limited, and satellite mission execution is also subject to various time and space constraints. Proper scheduling of satellite resources is essential to complete as many users' tasks as possible. Nevertheless, it is challenging and has been proven to be an NP-hard problem. To address this problem, we propose a hierarchical scheduling framework that combines an improved particle swarm algorithm with heuristic factors. The resource scheduling problem is divided into task assignment and resource scheduling in the timeline. This approach effectively reduces the complexity of the resource scheduling problem and promotes search performance. It also achieves the goals of load balance, ensuring stable satellite system operation and meeting users' requirements.

articleTitle: Anti-High Decibel Keyword Spotting System Based on Flexible Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Since speech is considered as one of the most important biological signals, keyword spotting (KWS) system enjoys a high level of acknowledgement when it comes to realizing human-human and human-computer interaction. Acoustic microphones are mostly utilized to collect airborne sound waves, but in factories and other noisy venues, the quality of speech collected by conventional method is far less satisfactory, causing a high false alarm rate. To deal with this problem, a novel embedded KWS system is proposed, where a flexible sensor to capture real-time vibration speech signals from the jaw is exploited. And a KWS algorithm based on non-acoustic signals is designed and transplanted into an embedded system. Compared with an acoustic microphone under 90dB conditions, the system has achieved an excellent anti-noise effect and a desired audio quality, which can be demonstrated by the experimental results, among which the average perceptual evaluation of speech quality(PESQ) and average short-time objective intelligibility(STOI) are 3.31 and 0.76, respectively. On top of that, the average accuracy of KWS is 83.53% under 90dB conditions. Its stable performance and resistance to noise make the system a promising tool for next-generation KWS and interaction systems.

articleTitle: Fully-Adjustable Test Signal Generation Module with Multi-Functional Outputs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The development of digital technology has driven the progress of the digital field. As a result, the development and testing of these complex digital systems require integrated test equipment with various functions to perform various stages of testing to ensure the effectiveness and accuracy of the system. The digital test signal plays an indispensable role in the testing process of digital systems. It is widely used as a test excitation source in the field of time-domain measurements such as integrated circuit testing, bus testing, and electronic measure-ments. However, traditional digital test signal generators are pretty bulky and limited in terms of test signal options and functions. This makes them inadequate for handling complex test scenarios. In order to tackle the problems mentioned above, this paper proposes a new architecture of a fully adjustable multi-functional digital test signal generator based on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA). This design approach reduces the use of hardware resources as well as integrates multiple digital test signal generation. Based on the proposed new design methodology, we have implemented a 16-channel digital test signal generator. The generator is capable of simulating a variety of digital test signal generation, and the 16 output channels can be independently controlled. Output digital test signal data rate is 1 kbit/s to 100 Mbit/s, adjustable resolution is 1 kbit/s. Customizable editing length 16 kbit/CH. Output signal supports voltage conditioning, output level range -1 V to +5 V, resolution 10 mV. And the rise time and fall time of the output signal can be adjusted.

articleTitle: A Novel Solution to the Inverse Kinematics Problem in Robotics Using Conditional Invertible Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Solving of the inverse kinematics(IK) problem is a challenging topic in the field of robotic arm controlling, due to the nonlinear, high computational costing, or ill-posed characteristic of IK problem. Various solutions have been proposed and most of them are still time-consuming or may cause unrealistic poses. This paper proposes a method based on Conditional Invertible Neural Networks(cINNs), designed to serve as a computational tool for solving the IK problem of 6 degrees of freedom (DOF) robotic arms. The bidirectional mapping characteristics of Invertible Neural Networks(INNs) are utilized and the joint positions of the previous state of the robotic arm are introduced as conditional constraints, enabling precise backward prediction of the positions of each joint of the robotic arm. Experimental results show that the method based on cINNs is more efficient than traditional inverse kinematics solution(IKS), and the accuracy rate remains stable between 99% and 97%. In contrast, the accuracy of IKS fluctuates considerably, ranging from 99.5% to 85%, especially when the target position is close to the operating boundary of the robotic arm, and then the error will significantly increase. These experimental results highlight the enormous potential and value of cINNs in solving inverse kinematics problems and emphasize the clear advantages of cINNs in terms of stability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Solving Tracking Challenges: Lightweight Algorithm for Single Pedestrian Tracking on Nano-UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With its pocket size and flexible flight characteristics, the nano-UAV can achieve more stealthy flight. If the full on-board deployment of the single pedestrian tracking algorithm can be realized on the nano-UAV, It will completely unmanned tasks such as personnel monitoring and security inspections, and has a broad application prospects. However, it is very challenging to design single pedestrian tracking algorithms for nano-UAV platforms. On the one hand, nano-UAVs are not able to deploy the algorithms fully on-board due to their strictly limited computing and storage resources; on the other hand, there are various tracking challenges (multi-scale changing target tracking, small-scale target tracking) for single pedestrian tracking tasks. In this paper, we design a lightweight single pedestrian tracking algorithm that ensures its resource footprint meets the limitations of nano-UAVs. The algorithm proposed in this paper consists of a multi-task learning front-end and a fused ReID tracking back-end, and we design a complete algorithm deployment process, including dataset construction, model training quantification and model deployment, which can effectively solve the challenges of current tracking tasks. A high efficiency (computational efficiency reaches 4.8 MACs/Cycle, and energy efficiency reaches 4.7 mJ/frame) has been achieved on the nano-UAV, achieving an accuracy score of 0.988 and a success score of 0.578 with good robustness in flight. The full-board deployment of nano-UAVs can achieve real-time tracking efficiency (28fps), which has application value and greatly promotes the research work of nano-UAVs.

articleTitle: Differentiated Time-Series Reconstruction for Anomaly Detection of Spacecraft Using Siamese Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the increasingly complex structure and challenging missions, anomaly detection of spacecraft becomes more and more important to ensure the operating reliability. But the abnormal events are not very common in practical applications. Therefore, it is meaningful to establish the anomaly detection model based on these abnormal samples. This research proposes a differentiated Siamese neural network-based time-series reconstruction technique. The autoencoder composed with Long short-term memory (LSTM) is established to extract the different characteristics within the samples in normal intervals and samples in abnormal intervals. The contrastive learning strategy are used to making full use of the existing anomalies. So that the trained autoencoder can enhance the difference between the normal samples and abnormal samples. With this Siamese neural network-based time-series reconstruction model, its statistical parameters the data reconstruction error can be used to clearly divide the normal and abnormal samples. The outcome of the experiment based on real spacecraft telemetry data collected by NASA illustrated that, using the existing time-series reconstruction model we constructed, the mean reconstruction error between samples in normal intervals and samples in abnormal intervals is higher than 0.117, and the mean value is 2.6706 as large as the value computed in the basic LSTM model, which means the proposed method can enhance the difference between normal samples and anomalies. This will be much helpful to realize the accurate anomaly detection for spacecraft.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Time-Synchronizing System Based on White Rabbit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the continuous development of national telecommunication technology, there is an urgent requirement to deploy high quality time-synchronizing systems in different distribution scenarios, such as 5G Communication, Smart Grid, and Astronomical Monitoring, in order to satisfy various requirements, such as improving wireless space spectrum utilization and PMU steady-state accuracy. Currently, the emerging WR technology can achieve sub-nanosecond synchronization errors. However, it still has some drawbacks, such as the large time fluctuation required for synchronization and the difficulty in fine-tuning the link delayed compensation.
