abstract: For correcting the color difference in machine vision imaging, all colors in the color space are usually used to train the correction model in traditional methods, which will lead to a complex training process of the model, long training time, and can not achieve high correction precision for each color. In order to solve these problems, a local color space correction scheme is proposed in this paper. In the scheme, the total color space is divided into smaller sub-color space based on color difference threshold and space distance respectively, and the colors in the sub-color space is corrected by polynomial regression method. The experimental results show that local color space correction has higher accuracy and more stable performance than total color space correction.

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Influence of Infrared Gas Composition Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of our country, the demand for new and clean energy is also increasing. In 2019, the state promulgated the Measures for Fair and Open Supervision of Oil and Gas Pipeline Network Facilities in which the requirements for establishing a natural gas energy measurement system were clarified. As an important measurement method of natural gas energy measurement, calorific value measurement has become the research focus. For calorific value measurement, infrared spectroscopy detection is a popular measurement method. The total calorific value of the gas is calculated by detecting the content of each component of the gas. The accuracy of infrared spectrum detection is high. Due to the characteristics of its absorption spectrum, the ambient temperature will affect it. According to the principle of infrared spectrum detection Lambert Beer law, the detection model of gas absorbance is established through analysis and calculation. By analyzing the detection model, the linear relationship between ambient temperature and spectral absorption was obtained, and the method to reduce the influence of temperature was analyzed by using the relationship. The feasibility of the method is verified by experiments. The control of ambient temperature and the selection of absorption spectrum based on temperature can greatly reduce the impact of temperature and improve the accuracy of infrared spectrum detection.

articleTitle: Neural Network Based Compensation Method for Frequency Response Mismatch in Wideband Quadrature Signal Reception System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The broadband quadrature reception system adopts a time interleaved sampling structure to perform high-speed sampling on the phase/quadrature (I/Q) signals after quadrature mixing, in order to meet the high bandwidth and high-speed sampling requirements of the system. In response to the serious impact of time-interleaved analog to digital converter (TIADC) mismatch and I/Q imbalance errors on key indicators of the system, this paper proposes a joint compensation method based on linear neural networks. This method uses the end-to-end compensation method to jointly compensate for the two errors without establishing an accurate joint error model, and simulation results have demonstrated the effectiveness of this method. In addition, the network model has scalability, and future research can further include more types of system distortion errors and perform joint compensation.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of P-R-N-D Shifting Force Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As an important reference indicator for transmissions, it is necessary to conduct offline testing of PRND shifting force. By studying the shift force of PRND(Parking, Reverse, Neutral, and Drive), a fault prediction method for PRND shift force based on BP neural network is proposed to improve the offline detection efficiency of PRND shift force. Based on the data obtained from the offline detection platform, a dataset for network training is obtained after processing; Build a PRND shift force fault prediction model, design and train a BP neural network, and after error backpropagation, the next layer gradient determines the gradient of the current layer to obtain the prediction network; Bringing the dataset into the network for simulation and comparing the simulation results, it was found that the network can achieve ideal results.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Capacitive/Eddy Current Thermal Barrier Coating Thickness Composite Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a modeling and design method for a capacitive/eddy-current composite sensor for thermal barrier coating thickness detection. This composite sensor has a smaller size and faster detection speed because it integrates two detection methods in the same sensor. It has the advantage of being non-invasive and radiation-free. The performance of the sensor was studied by the finite element method using Comsol Multiphysics simulation software. The results of the simulation show the variation of the capacitance and the voltage concerning the variation of the layer thickness. Based on this simulation model, the structure of the sensor is modified to achieve the best sensitivity. The simulation results show that the design parameters of the sensor have different patterns of influence on the detection performance of the two modes. Through the comprehensive consideration of the influence law of each factor, it is expected to achieve the improvement of detection performance and guide the optimization of sensor design.

articleTitle: A Novel Motion Compensation Framework for Micro UAV FMCW SAR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Micro UAV gives easily rise to motion error with low amplitude and high frequency. In Micro UAV SAR imaging, the motion error is always 2-D space variant. The high frequency motion error with 2-D space variant property challenges the traditional compensation algorithms. The existing RCBC algorithm can compensate the range-variant motion error effectively for FMCW system. However, its efficiency is very low and only azimuth-invariant error is taken into account. This paper analyzes the imaging characteristics of FMCW SAR and establishes a novel compensation framework for high frequency motion error with 2-D space variant property. The framework first simplifies the “Range cell-by-cell” algorithm using local space invariance of error to obtain the RBBC algorithm. Subsequently, we introduce the traditional FDA to compensate the AVPE, which is ignored in RCBC. Finally, the simulation experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed compensation framework.

articleTitle: A Magnitude-Response Compensation Method in the FI-DAC-Based Arbitrary Waveform Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: An arbitrary waveform generator (A WG) is a general-purpose testing device that can easily generate excitation signals according to user needs. With the continuous evolution of electronic science and technology, increasing demands for a higher AWG sampling rate and output bandwidth has been put forward. A frequency-interleaved digital-to-analog converter (FI-DAC) can improve those parameters quite effectively. However, due to the magnitude roll-off characteristic of the DAC and the magnitude attenuation of analog devices, such as filters, mixers, and combiners, in the FI-DAC structure, the output signal exhibits serious magnitude distortion. Hence, in this paper we establish an error model for an FI-DAC and propose a minimax method to design the magnitude-response compensation filter. Finally, the performance of the designed compensation filter was validated using a purpose-built experimental test bench.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Remote Electric Energy Monitoring at the Plant Level
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the electric energy data has not realized remote centralized monitoring, the remote monitoring of electric energy data based on LAN (Local Area Network) is designed, multi-level redundancy is set to improve system reliability; for newly installed energy meters, the field data acquisition interface software is made to realize the field data acquisition; the KepserverEX OPC(OLE for Process Control) server and WinCC(Windows Control Center) platform server are configured to realize data transmission between local data terminal and Siemens WinCC monitoring platform; the electric energy monitoring program interface is developed on the Siemens WinCC monitoring platform to realize remote centralized monitoring of electric energy data, including electric data for the current month and the first eleven months; it is verified that it can meet the performance requirements for correct information display, short response time, quick return.

articleTitle: Research on 256QAM with Large Instantaneous Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As an efficient modulation technique for joint carrier amplitude and phase, Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) is a widely used modulation method in modern communications. This article designs a system of 256QAM modulation signal synthesis technology, which supports scrambling, serial data to parallel data, differential coding, channel coding, constellation mapping, shaping filtering, and digital modulation. This article also provides verification tests for the key blocks of the 256QAM algorithm, including the functional test of the scrambling block, the functional test of the shaping filter module, and the functional test of the overall modulated signal. The test results show that the designed module meets the design requirements and meets the expected indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Broadband Complex Electromagnetic Environment Signal Simulation Technology Based on Channel Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on an efficient channelized structure, this research focuses on channelized reception, channel reconstruction transmission, and baseband signal generation. A broadband complex electromagnetic signal simulation method is proposed, and a design of the simulation scheme for broadband complex electromagnetic signals is implemented using domestically produced devices. Through simulation and experiments, it is demonstrated that this method can achieve multi-target simulation capability in a complex electromagnetic environment with an instantaneous bandwidth of 4 GHz. It can also be extended for applications in radar target simulators ranging from 0.8 GHz to 18 GHz.

articleTitle: Steel Defect Detection Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The application of object detection in various fields is becoming increasingly widespread, and the use of detection algorithms for defect detection is also becoming increasingly important. This article adds an attention mechanism to the original Y010v7 network to reduce the loss of feature information caused by feature maps during pooling, strengthen the feature extraction ability in the network structure, and improve the accuracy of algorithm defect detection. The original bounding box Loss function is changed from CIOU to Focal EIOU, and an adjustable parameter gamma is introduced on the basis of EIOU to adjust the weight of difficult and easy targets. Compared with CIOU, Focal EIOU considers Aspect ratio and position offset, so it can better adapt to targets with different shapes and positions. Make the convergence process of model training faster, reduce losses, and increase the stability of the training process. Based on the improved steel defect detection algorithm, the detection speed on the NEU-DET dataset remains basically unchanged compared to the original algorithm, and mAP improves by 5.2% compared to the original algorithm. After adding attention mechanism and replacing Loss function in the network, the improved algorithm is more suitable for steel defect detection.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Channel Frequency Memory and Retransmission Module Based on $\text{AXI}4+\text{DDR}3$
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Digital Radio Frequency Memory (DRFM) is one of the key technologies that allow the radar system to accomplish electromagnetic interference. The dual-channel frequency memory and retransmission module with 5GSPS sampling rate, which is built in the “ADC + FPGA + dual DAC” hardware architecture, combines the multiport memory architecture of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AXI}4+\text{DDR}3$</tex> and the internal BRAM resources of FPGA, and it is logically designed to be a dual-channel module with one receiving port and two transmission ports. The two channels are mutually independent and controllable and can support fast retransmission and deep memory of DRFM. Fixed delay and automatic delay are realized in the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\mu\mathrm{s}\sim 100\text{ms}$</tex> range, with delay resolution <10ns.

articleTitle: Research on Linear Open Channel Current Meter Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The linear open channel water velocity standard device uses servo motor to control and measure the speed of the test car, which makes the test car run on the track. The detecting car pulls the current meter at the speed range of (0.1–5) m/s, so that the current meter travels in still water. By measuring the speed of the detecting car and the speed of the current meter, the relative relationship between the two sets of data is established with equations or charts, so as to achieve the purpose of detecting the current meter. In this experiment, Doppler ultrasonic current meter with good accuracy and stability was used to test on the device to verify the repeatability and stability of the device, and at the same time, the device was compared with other laboratory devices to further confirm the detection ability of the device. The uncertainty of measurement results is evaluated, and the relative extended uncertainty of measurement results at the flow rate of 1.0m/s is 0.18% <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(k=2)$</tex>, which proves that the accuracy level of the device is high.

articleTitle: Fault Identification in Distribution Network by Fusing Deep Residual Shrinkage Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Distribution network fault identification can increase the network's stability and safety and has great application value for smart grids. This study demonstrates a network topology based on traveling wave theory coupled with a 10kV distribution network to increase the precision and ease of fault diagnosis in the distribution network. When a fault develops in the 10 kV distribution network, this structure may assess the traveling wave propagation process, voltage, and current traveling wave signals produced, and search for a quick, precise, and reliable way to pinpoint the fault spot. Additionally, a reasonable fault location system scheme is proposed. This scheme eliminates the complex reflection process of traveling waves in the distribution network, simplifies the calculation, has a unified method, and has good algorithm universality. This system improves fault location accuracy with a maximum error of 14 meters, shortens the fault location time, greatly improves power supply reliability, and allows applying the traveling wave fault location method to the distribution network.

articleTitle: Design of Underwater Multi-Parameter Magnetic Detection Data Synchronous Acquisition System Based on NI CompactRIO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the increasing demand for fine and efficient detection of underwater magnetic field in the field of marine exploration, especially in the military field, a modular data acquisition scheme integrating magnetic sensors and underwater positioning sensors is proposed, and an underwater multi-parameter data acquisition system based on NI CompactRIO is constructed. The system integrates two cesium optically pumped magnetometers, fluxgate magnetometers, and underwater integrated navigation and positioning modules to meet the experimental requirements under different conditions. In order to solve the problem of data synchronization when multiple sensors are collected at the same time, a synchronization scheme based on the external Oven Controlled Crystal Oscillator reference signal source is proposed. While ensuring data synchronization in the underwater environment where PPS signals cannot be received, the influence of ambient temperature changes on synchronization is further reduced. The output signal measurement module of dual-channel cesium optically pumped magnetometer is realized by using the improved direct frequency measurement method. This method improves the frequency measurement accuracy on the basis of ensuring multi-channel consistency. The acquisition system is based on the modular design concept, which can efficiently complete the acquisition task, and is easy to integrate and has high application value.

articleTitle: Design of Anti-interference Defibrillator with Short Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Ventricular fibrillation, atrial fibrillation, and other malignant arrhythmias are the main causes of human death. Defibrillator is an effective device to terminate abnormal heart rhythms and to deliver an electric shock to control heart activity. However, most existing defibrillation devices can only treat ventricular fibrillation and cannot handle abnormal rhythms such as atrial fibrillation that require synchronized defibrillation. A few devices that can perform synchronous defibrillation also have some obvious drawbacks, including significant synchronization time delay and limitations in reliability and anti-interference. In this study, we designed a novel synchronous defibrillator with high anti-interference and short delay for treating abnormal heart rhythms that require synchronous defibrillation. This defibrillator could collect electrocardiogram signals in real-time, recognize the R-waves, and release defibrillation energy at appropriate time. The discharge of this device occurred in the absolute refractory period of the heart, rather than during the ventricular vulnerable period near the peak of the T wave. The experimental results showed that this new synchronous defibrillator accurately recognized the R waves even in severe baseline drift and high-frequency interference situations. The synchronous defibrillator only took 1ms to recognize the R-wave and complete the discharge, significantly lower than the other commercialized defibrillators. This innovative defibrillator can be used in multiple scenarios of emergency and may promote the first-aid capacity for cardiovascular disorders.

articleTitle: Airspeed Anomaly Detection of UAV Based on Flight Mode Adaptive with Noise Margin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has been widely used. In order to ensure the completion of the mission, prognostic and health management (PHM) of UAV has been focused on. Airspeed anomaly detection is an important part of UAV PHM. However, most of the existing methods only use single model for different flight modes or phases. This will reduce the accuracy of the model. Therefore, in this paper, a set of airspeed anomaly detection models based on flight mode adaption with noise margin which will further improve the accuracy of precision are raised. This method estimate the airspeed with different Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Recurrent Neural Network based the flight mode. In order to detect the faults, PauTa criterion is applied. To verify the effectiveness of the method, the models are deployed on real flight data. The result of the experiment proves that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection of Nuclear Fuel Pellets using Structured Light and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Surface defect detection of nuclear fuel pellets is crucial for the efficient and safe operation of nuclear reactors. In this study, a defect detection method based on structured light and convolutional neural network is proposed to address the challenges posed by small-sized fuel pellets, varying forms and sizes of pellet end face defects, and complex background environments. The method utilizes DLP technology and a Scheimpflug lens to construct a high-performance structured light imaging device. Subsequently, a deep network model named Defect-Deepf.abv. + is designed for processing structured light images. Building upon DeepLab <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3+$</tex>, the network adopts MobilenetV2 as the encoder backbone and incorporates the CBAM attention mechanism, effectively enhancing defect segmentation accuracy. The experimental results show that our method achieves an F1 score of 95.6% on structured light images. Moreover, the detection time for a single pellet is less than 1 second, meeting the real-time quality inspection demands of the production line for nuclear fuel pellets.

articleTitle: Research on SiPIN Detection Efficiency Calibration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In contrast to the traditional experimental approach to detector detection efficiency calibration, the use of a monoenergetic X-ray radiation device for efficiency calibration is the preferred alternative for X-ray detector calibration because of the capability of measuring multiple energy points and the advantages of adjustable energy and outstanding monochromaticity of the monoenergetic X-ray radiation device. In this work, the experimental calibration of SiPIN detectors is performed in the (5~40)keV monoenergetic X-ray radiation devices with a calibration range of from 8 to 25 keV, and the relative error between the experimental calibration results and the simulation results is within ±6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. 23 keV and 25 keV results are 6.28% and −5.01%, respectively. The high relative error is due to the fact that the detection efficiency of the standard detector, HPGe, in the energy range, is more than 93 %, resulting in a high total photon count of the X-ray beam, while the detection efficiency of the SiPIN detector in the energy range is less than 30% and the total photon count is low, which causes a large relative error between the experimental and simulation results. This work has demonstrated the feasibility of the SiPIN detector in measuring soft X-rays and provided a guarantee for the calibration of the detector in the low energy range.

articleTitle: Three-Degree-of-Freedom Absolute Displacement Sensor Based on Planar Magnetic Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To meet the demand for high precision over long-range multi-degree-of-freedom displacement measurement systems in industrial production, this paper proposed a novel three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) absolute displacement sensor to achieve absolute displacement measurement in the plane. The structure of the sensor consists of a moving planar magnetic grid and a fixed sensor board, multiple square permanent magnetics arranged in the plane constitute the planar magnetic grid, and the sensor board uses a matrix of Hall sensors to collect the magnetic field signals and provide the long-range absolute position measurement reference. The principle of displacement measurement in the plane 3-DOF (x, y, and R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf>) is analyzed, and the method of the long-range linear absolute displacement measurement is proposed. Finally, the experiment results demonstrate that the prototype sensor achieves 10μm resolution in the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$y$</tex> directions and 0.1° angular resolution around the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$z$</tex> direction.

articleTitle: Research of 808/980 nm Dual-Wavelength High-Power Laser Therapy Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Laser plays an increasingly important role in alleviating muscle fatigue. In this paper, we designed a laser therapeutic device with high-power 808/980 nm dual-wavelength semiconductor laser and a control system. The system architecture mainly consists of a laser module, a laser power constant current source driving module, a main controller module based on STM32 and software modules. Communication is done via the RS232 protocol to facilitate data display, touchscreen interface response and control. The software module is responsible for the embedded software of the high-power dual-wavelength semiconductor laser. Finally, the entire system was tested, and the experimental results demonstrate that the actual output power of the high-power dual-wavelength laser deviates by less than 2% from the set power, indicating its stable and reliable output. The overall system design is reasonable and exhibits excellent performance.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Direct Current Coefficient of I/V Transducer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Direct current coefficient is an essential parameter of I/V transducer, which directly affects the measurement results. Traditional method, comparing the measured transducer with the standard transducer, has limitations; failure to solve the problem in essence. To measure the direct current coefficient accurately, a measuring device was developed, which consists of direct current source, standard direct current ratio, adjustable standard direct current ratio, standard I/V transducer, voltage meter and null indicator. A measurement method was proposed, which fixes the value of direct current source and current flowing through the standard I/V transducer; adjusts the current through the high accuracy ratio conversion. The error measurement principle was employed to minimize the influence on the measurement results. Measure the current coefficient of an I/V transducer and restore its actual working state. The result shows that the current coefficients in the four current ranges are all negative, and are basically in the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>. The proposed method is characterized by breaking dependence on the superior standard device and meets the needs of precise measurement result correction.

articleTitle: Synchronization Design Method for High-Speed Signal Transmission Between FPGAs in DIGITAL Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Ultra-high-speed data acquisition systems generally adopt a “master-slave“ FPGA control architecture. Under this architecture, the synchronous transmission of signals between multiple FPGAs is an important prerequisite for realizing the synchronization and accurate acquisition of the acquisition system. This paper focuses on the problem of synchronous signal transmission between multiple FPGA boards and proposes a method for synchronous transmission of high-speed signals between FPGAs. With the help of the IODELAY unit of the FPGA, the most stable synchronous transmission interval is found through the test data training, and the L VDS and SERDES synchronous transmission of multiple lanes between multiple FPGAs is realized. Experiments on a self-made digital oscilloscope show that this method can effectively realize the synchronous transmission of high-speed signals between FPGAs.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Optical Fiber Turbidity Sensor for Turbidity Monitoring in Constricted Space
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that existing turbidity sensor is difficult to be applied to constricted space because of its large size and easy to be interfered by stray light, a miniaturized turbidity sensor based on 90° scattered light measurement principle is designed. The sensor adopts the flexible glass fiber bundle as the light guide medium to realize miniaturization design, and adopts the stray light protection parts design to avoid the influence of stray light on measurement, these measures effectively improved the environmental adaptability of the sensor in constricted spaces. At the same time, the sensor also has a dynamic compensation function of light source, which avoids the influence of sensor light source fluctuation on measurement and improves the accuracy of the sensor. The measuring principle and design method of the sensor are introduced, and the performance of the sensor is verified according to the application requirements. The experimental results show that the sensor has great accuracy and stability, and can be used in various turbidity monitoring occasions, especially in constricted spaces.

articleTitle: Design of Control Module for Marine Biogenic Monitoring System in Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the growing global demand for clean energy, nuclear energy has gained widespread attention as a reliable and low-carbon energy source. Biological activities in the marine environment have a significant impact on the safe operation of nuclear power plants. In order to detect and assess the biological activity in the marine environment in a timely manner and provide effective early warning and countermeasures, a marine biological monitoring system for nuclear power plants is designed to monitor and assess the biological communities in the surrounding waters in real time. This paper introduces the system structure and hardware components, and focuses on the circuit design of the data acquisition and status monitoring parts. The system will help to understand the status of marine communities around nuclear power plants and provide accurate data support to protect the safety of the marine environment around nuclear power plants after operation.

articleTitle: Angle Measurement Method Based on Cross-Orthogonal Hall Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Angle measurement sensors have gained widespread application in fields of automobiles, machinery, and other industries. The cross-orthogonal architecture based on Hall sensors is proposed to position angle. Meanwhile, A novel angle calibration algorithm effectively reduces the error caused by the offset voltage, the unequal amplitude and the additional harmonics. A special FPGA test has been designed to measure the angle of rotation of the artificial magnetic field and verify the proposed methods. The angle measurement results show an average measured error of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 1.263^{\circ}$</tex>, which can meet the requirements of industrial and practical applications.

articleTitle: A Kind of Research on the Visual Inspection Device of Gantry Aircraft Parts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In response to the demand for rapid and high-precision measurement of aircraft parts, this article proposes an aircraft part detection device based on machine vision measurement, it device has been selected and arranged for the ball screw slide used for measurement. The overall system of the sliding platform and stage has been designed, using machine vision detection technology to collect data and images, feature extraction and part classification are performed on the edges of parts, achieving fast and high-precision measurement of aircraft parts. This article discusses the main composition, working principle, and implementation steps of the visual inspection device for gantry aircraft parts, the structural parameter design and strength verification of the ball screw slide and measurement area, as well as the selection of visual systems. On this basis, through finite element analysis, the key component models are effectively analyzed and validated, proving that the visual inspection device for gantry aircraft parts can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Effect of Flow Rate or Pressure on the Potential of Tungsten Oxide Placed in Flowing Liquid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this study, based on the phenomenon of solid-liquid electricity generation, the core sensitivity of tungsten oxide in flowing liquids is verified to be the liquid pressure rather than the flow rate by designing asymmetric and symmetric system experiments. The tungsten oxide electrode is also calibrated with a high-precision resistive liquid pressure sensor, and the sensitivity of the tungsten oxide liquid pressure sensor is found to be 0.18949 (V/kPa). Meanwhile, the Nyquist plots of the tungsten oxide electrode at different liquid pressures are obtained using the electrochemical impedance spectroscopy testing technique, and the equivalent circuit model of electrical double layer (EDL) on the tungsten oxide/liquid interface is derived. It is further revealed that the higher the liquid pressure, the thinner the thickness of EDL on the tungsten oxide/liquid interface and the lower the output potential of the tungsten oxide. This not only enriches the application of solid-liquid electricity generation in self-powered sensing, but also provides strong evidence for EDL theory in solid-liquid electricity generation.

articleTitle: Design of Real-Time Vibration Environment Parameter Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to monitor the vibration of environmental parameters during equipment transportation and storage, a real-time monitoring environmental vibration parameters acquisition system is designed. The system adopts the structural design of separation of sensor and main equipment, and supports the collection and storage of up to 8 three-axis vibration data at the same time, so as to realize the monitoring, recording, and analysis of environmental vibration status. Through the shaker test and the field test of large vessels, it is verified that the system can monitor the vibration component of the three axes in the environment in real-time, and the equipment can operate stably and reliably and has the advantages of high real-time performance and high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Measurements and Calculation Methods of Jitter in Broadband Sampling Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Jitter is one of the important factors that affect the measurement accuracy of broadband sampling oscilloscopes. The description of jitter varies across different fields, and therefore, the definition and classification of jitter differ among international organizations. This paper analyzes the sources and definitions of jitter involved in the time-domain measurements of broadband sampling oscilloscopes and characterizes jitter using Root-Mean-Square Jitter (jitter rms) and Peak-to-Peak Jitter *(jitter p-p) for a more rigorous and accurate representation. Additionally, this paper conducts research using Keysight Flex DCA simulation software as a platform and provides the calculation methods for jitter rms and jitter p-p in the Keysight NIOOO series broadband sampling oscilloscopes.

articleTitle: Calibration Method for Light Screen-Based Speed Measurement Devices for Projectile
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Light screen-based speed measurement device for projectile (SMDP) has been widely used by forensic science institutes of public security agencies for firearms identification in China, and it is required be calibrated every year to ensure the speed measurement accuracy and traceability. A calibration method based on multi-channel time delay simulation and live ammunition firing comparison is proposed for calibrating the light screen-based SMDP in this paper. The calibration facilities for dual and triple light screen-based SMDP are specially realized to verify the proposed calibration method. The speed calibration range of the calibration facilities exceeds <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(20\sim1000)\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$</tex> and the maximum permissible error is superior to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 0.01\ \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$</tex>, which can meet the requirements of light screen-based SMDP for speed calibration range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(20\sim1000) \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$</tex> and speed calibration accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0. 3\ \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$</tex>. The comparison results of a triple light screen-based SMDP sample validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed calibration method and the realized calibration facilities.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Parallel Test System Based on Dual-ICA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Parallel testing is one of the key technologies to improve the test efficiency of ATS, To solve the problems that parallel testing based on time-division multiplexing is not suitable for test items with dependencies and the unstable test process caused by the uncertain fault state of the UUT, a parallel test system based on dual-ICA is proposed to realize the parallel test by increasing certain general test resources. Firstly, through hardware analysis, determine the types of test resources with increased demand and the structure of the automatic test system. Secondly, through the software process design, analyze whether the measured object uses general resources or competing resources, and on this basis, a method for generating a parallel test relationship matrix is proposed, and the automatic test system can determine whether the two tested objects can be tested in parallel by querying the relationship matrix; Finally, the implementation process of the above steps is explained through case analysis, and the effectiveness of the method is verified. The above method has been successfully applied in a certain type of automatic test system.

articleTitle: Soft Fault Diagnosis Technology of Filter Circuit Based on Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Recently, with an aim to improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of filter circuit in electronic equipment, ensemble learning method, a branch of machine learning has been emerging as a promising tool for applications with electronic area. To uncover its potentials in filter circuit, a soft fault diagnosis method based on heterogeneous ensemble learning is illustrated in this paper. The proposed method does not need to analysis the underlying transfer function of the circuit. Alternatively, it explored an effective ensemble model for fault diagnosis with three weak learners: linear regression, support vector machine (SVM) and decision tree, which establish the mapping function between fault features and output voltage. Then the fault classification also can be achieved by the proposed model. Finally, the experimental results with Sallen-Key filter circuit demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Inverse Electromagnetic Imaging via Time-Reversal Method of Moments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The electromagnetic sensing and imaging has many potential important applications such as localization and identification. Advanced methods need to be developed for fast and accurate electromagnetic image reconstruction, especially when the received electromagnetic signals are corrupted by a large amount of noise and interference. Here we propose such advanced method to tackle this problem through combination of the electromagnetic time reversal method and the Method of Moments (MoM), with the help of reciprocity theorem. First, electromagnetic time reversal method in the frequency domain is used to obtain the approximate electromagnetic image; then the reduced estimated image domain is obtained by thresholding the intensity of the roughly reconstruct image; finally, with the help of electromagnetic reciprocity theorem, the MoM is applied to the reduced image domain to reconstruct the electromagnetic image efficiently. Simulations have been performed for an electromagnetic sensing and imaging metallic cube system with 3 radiating dipole antennas and 28 receiving antennas aligned in the vertical direction to validate our proposed method, and the results are very promising.

articleTitle: The Characterization of Near-Field Microwave Radiation Via Scanning Probe Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Surface microwave field imaging is an important method for evaluating the performance of microwave/millimeter-wave monolithic integrated circuits. It is crucial to conduct the detection at the micro-nano scale. In the near-field scanning microwave microscopy system, the local signal of the surface radiation field is coupled with the tip signal, and the S11 curve related to the reflected signal is obtained. The curve exhibits varying degrees of sinusoidal oscillation as the radiation intensity changes at the specified position. The microwave intensity at this point is represented by the peak-to-peak value of the oscillation curve. Finally, the surface microwave intensity is mapped by scanning point by point. This method is crucial for evaluating the reliability of on-chip integrated circuit signal transmission and for the design and manufacture of devices.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of a Miniature Four-Axial Piezoresistive Force/Torque Sensor with MEMS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel miniature four-dimensional force/torque piezoresistive force sensor is presented in this paper. The silicon sensor is fabricated using standard MEMS technologies. The cross-beam structure is adopted in this design due to its high mechanical stability. Twelve n-doped silicon piezoresistive strain gauges are located on the different positions of the cross-beams. Finite element simulations assess the stress distribution and help with piezoresistors arrangement. The sensor can simultaneously detect three directions of forces (F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>, and Fz) and a torque M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf> in the plane by four independent Wheatstone bridges. A series of precise gravity masses were used to characterize the sensor performance. Results show the properties of good linearity, high sensitivity, small crosstalk, and highly dynamic response (2ms).

articleTitle: Parameter Selection Method for Accuracy Optimization of Time-Grating Displacement Sensor Based on Orthogonal Experimental Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Time-grating displacement sensors have been widely used in various application fields such as machineries., automobiles., aerospace., and defense with their merits of high accuracy., reliability., and low cost. However., the problem of over-reliance on experience during the product parameter design process without scientific advisory was exposed during the time-grating sensor manufacturing process. In addition., it brought about the problems of production efficiency decline due to delayed design and experimental processes. This paper discusses the influence of different stages on the optimum parameters of a Time-grating displacement sensor. By using the orthogonal experiments and the intuitive analysis of the experiment findings., this paper aims to provide reliable and effective strategies for the component design of a Time-grating displacement sensor. The influence of different parameters on the sensor's accuracy was studied by establishing a sensor model and using finite element simulation software experiments. The experimental results show that other parameters correlate with accuracy., among which pole number and excitation signal significantly impact sensor accuracy. The research work carried out in this paper can provide a basis for various parameter designs in the production process and has a certain reference value for the optimal design of time-grating sensors.

articleTitle: Research on Standard Time Replication Method Based on Multi-Reference Terminal Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of users for standard time frequency signals, the National Time Service Center Time frequency Laboratory has established a set of standard time remote replication system, and its users are distributed in multiple sites across the country. The regular working mode of the system is point-to-multi-broadcast service, which puts forward higher requirements for the reliable and stable operation of the reference terminal. Aiming at the limitations of the existing standard time remote replication system, this paper proposes a standard time replication method based on the fusion of multi-reference terminals, which not only solves the problem that a single reference terminal cannot guarantee the continuity and stability of the system in the event of sudden anomalies, but also finds that the recurrence capability of multi-reference terminal fusion is superior to that of a single reference terminal through comparative test and experiment. The results show that the standard deviation is increased from 1.3ns to O.55ns, and the peaking value is increased from 10.74ns to 3.57ns, which can meet the high precision and high reliability requirements of users for standard time-frequency signals.

articleTitle: Research on Total Radiation Dose Detection by Chromaticity Based on Radiochromic Film
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A new total dose detection system for space radiation has been developed, based on radiochromic film. This system allows for real-time online monitoring and distributed multi-point detection of space radiation dose. The discovery of the radiation discoloration effect has enabled the use of radiation discoloration film for total radiation dose detection. However, most current methods for detecting total radiation dose using radiation discoloration film are offline, which poses a challenge when it comes to achieving distributed detection and online real-time monitoring. The radiochromic film will undergo a color change after exposure to high-energy particles or rays, and the intensity of the color change is directly related to the radiation dose. To establish the correlation between the depth of color change in the film and the total radiation dose, a chromaticity detection method was employed, based on the principles of digital colorimetry theory and the RGB color space. The RGB value of the film was used to characterize the absorbed total radiation dose. A specific probe structure was designed and detailed, and ultraviolet irradiation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the total radiation dose detection method.

articleTitle: Design of Reliable Estimator for the Number of Missing Tags
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the application of radio frequency identification (RFID) technology further expansion, its related fields including warehouse management, smart healthcare. Missing tag cardinality estimation is still a problem in current RFID management. In this paper, we design a scheme that can accurately estimate the missing tag number over unreliable channels, taking into account the influence of unknown tags. By recording the joint states of each pair of matched time slots in the expected frame and the response frame, an estimator is designed based on the analysis of probability of event <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N_{\ast, 0}$</tex> (the response time slot is decoded into an empty time slot by RFID reader, and the time slot state of the expected frame is arbitrary) and event <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N_{0,0}$</tex> (both the time slot of the expected frame and the slot of the response frame are considered to be empty by the RFID reader). Through simulation, it is found that compared with the existing schemes, the estimation reliability of our proposed scheme is significantly better than other schemes, and it can meet the given estimation accuracy and reliability parameters.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of UWB Radome
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, taking the nose radome as an example, the weighted average incidence angle is used as the design angle to obtain the wall thickness distribution, and the three-dimensional electrical performance calculation and analysis of the whole cover is used to optimize the design of the wall thickness distribution in a cyclic iterative manner. The cloud variable thickness radome modeling method discusses the design process of the variable thickness curved surface radome in detail; through the analysis of the electrical performance of the radome, the efficiency of the design method is proved, and it is an ultra-wideband aircraft radar antenna. The development of the hood provides important scientific significance.

articleTitle: Small Target Detection Method on Sea Surface Based on T-GCN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Improving the detection ability of small targets in sea clutter is always a popular subject in the field of radar technology. The traditional sea clutter prediction method only considers the fluid alteration of radar echo, but neglects the spatial correlation. This research proposes a new temporal graph convolutional network (T-GCN) detection technique for tiny sea surface targets. Multiple historical sea clutter sequences are input by recurrence plot (RP). In this case, the graph convolutional neural network extract spatial characteristics from numerous sequences by capturing their topological structure. The time series is input to the gated recursive unit. Prediction result is output using the time characteristics. Experiments show that T-GCN can get spatiotemporal properties from sea clutter model, and the prediction results are better than that of support vector regression model, temporal dynamic model constructed by gated recursive unit and spatial correlation model constructed by graph convolutional network, which increases the visibility of small sea surface targets and offers a fresh concept and method for predicting sea clutter.

articleTitle: Improved Double N-Step Phase Shift Method(DNPSM) Based on Unwrapping Before Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the field of fringe projection profile, the DNPSM becomes a research hotspot because of its small phase error and high detection accuracy. However, the DNPSM is affected by periodic phase error(PPE) in the wrapped phase fusion process, and it produces spurious tones at the edge position of the wrapped phase. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved DNPSM based on unwrapping before fusion. Firstly, we get wrapped phase from the two sets of phase shift fringe images(PSFI) captured by camera, and then we unwrap the two groups of wrapped phase with the phase unwrapping method. Finally, we fuse the two unwrapped phase. We use the proposed method compared with complementary Gray code(CGC) N-step phase shift method(NPSM) and CGC-DNPSM that wrapping after fusing respectively. Experimental results show our method could effectively eliminate spurious tones in phase and improve the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Two Dimensional Three-Axis Magnetic Field Distribution Measurement by SERF Atomic Magnetometer Using Spatial Light Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The spin-exchange relaxation-free (SERF) atomic magnetometer has high sensitivity for magnetic field measurement, and is of great significance in frontier physics research, biomagnetic detection and other fields. In recent years, as one of the important development directions, its high spatial resolution and multi-channel magnetic field detection capabilities have been further extended. In this paper, based on the three-axis in-situ magnetic field zeroing method (MFZM), the accurate measurement of three-axis static magnetic field is realized, and the using of the digital micro-mirror device (DMD) further supports the measurement of two-dimensional three-axis magnetic field distribution in a specific area. Then, the experimental system was set up and realized the three-axis magnetic field measurement of 25 points within the 4 mm × 4 mm two-dimensional measurement range, and the resolution of each point is a square area with a side length of 0.8 mm. The proposed method based on the SERF atomic magnetometer can measure the triaxial magnetic field in the internal micro-regions in the magnetic field coil, magnetic shield, etc., helping the analysis and evaluation of the high-resolution magnetic field distribution.

articleTitle: Fourth-Order Cumulants-Based Eigen-Decomposition Techniques for Loran - C Skywave Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The positioning accuracy of the Loran-C signal will be interfered with by the aliasing of sky and earth waves. Separating the skywave and groundwave with appropriate methods can effectively improve positioning accuracy. In this paper, we propose the eigendecomposition spectral analysis technique based on fourth-order cumulants to calculate the delay of the Loran-C skywave. Their accuracy is compared with that of traditional eigendecomposition spectroscopy. At the same time, the analysis results based on the actual collected data are given. The results show that the new technology can effectively suppress the influence of Gaussian noise, the wave generated by noise is 80% lower than the traditional algorithm, effectively reduce the effect of noise, can more accurately identify the skywave delay, and expand the number of arrays to twice the conventional algorithm, which makes the technology can effectively reduce the interference of other Loran-C signals. In a bad environment, the algorithm can still have good positioning accuracy and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Design of Depth Measurement System for Seafloor Sediment Temperature and Salinity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on the requirements of developing a small-size, low-cost, and high-precision temperature-salinity-depth measurement system, this paper designs a marine multi-parameter measurement system with STM32 as the core control chip, equipped with conductivity sensors, liquid level sensors, and temperature sensors. At the same time, a PC software system compatible with the measurement system is developed based on the LabVIEW platform. The measurement system has an independent power supply system and data storage SD card, enabling it to operate independently for measurement without connecting to a PC, or to transfer data via serial port for more powerful data processing and analysis by the PC. Experimental data demonstrate that the accuracy of the salinity, depth, and temperature measurements obtained by this system meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Portable Resonant Density Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A resonant density meter is a sensor used to measure the density of a fluid, where a change in density causes a change in the mass loading of the resonator structure, resulting in a change in the resonant frequency. In this article, key properties of mechanical resonators that determine the overall performance of density meter are described. The traditional straight tube or U-shaped tube structure is not suitable for portable equipment, so a resonator with a double-tube structure is designed. Since the two straight tubes vibrate in opposite directions, the bending moment and vibration force are canceled at the root, so that the sensor does not need counterweight. First, through theoretical derivation, a physical model of the resonant sensor is established, and the expressions of frequency and quality factor are derived. Next, the structure and circuit of the sensor are introduced, and finally the experiment proves that the sensor has excellent stability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Wavelet Time-Frequency Analysis for Multi-Domain Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Wavelet time-frequency analysis is widely used in electronic measurement and fault diagnosis areas. For multi-domain oscilloscope (MDO) applications, the ability to analyze the spectrum of wideband signals is demanded. Unfortunately, limited by the digital signal processing capability of the MDO, the frequency resolution is too low to inspect the wideband signal accurately. Moreover, the frequency domain is independent of the time domain, which means the information in the time-frequency domain is ignored. In this work, an optimized wavelet structure is designed based on the coefficient approximation extraction algorithm. The coefficient decimation scheme provides a flexible way for frequency resolution adjustment. The wavelet transform is performed in the Field programmable gate array device(FPGA), and the time resolution of the wavelet transform can be manipulated by controlling the input data accessing. These wavelet results are uploaded to the Industrial Personal Computer and provide a time-frequency perspective in real time. The wavelet scale parameter and coefficients are stored on the hardware side, these parameter can be accessed flexibly, which accelerate the wavelet transform process. By omitting the nonzero values of the parameters, resource consumption has been reduced by 30%. The time-sharing multiplexing technology is applied in the wavelet transform unit to save the multiplier resource. The designed wavelet structure is evaluated on a verification platform, the BPSK and AM modulation signal are used for the verification. The input signal has a bandwidth of 8 GHz and a sampling rate of 20 GSPS. The trend of the frequency and phase shift can be detected accurately, the temporal resolution of time-frequency analysis is 1us, and the frequency resolution is up to 1 MHz.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Auto-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Bearings are important components in the operation of mechanical equipment, but the current intelligent diagnosis methods have a low recognition rate in complex environments and variable working conditions. Considering the advantages of deep learning in data processing and feature extraction (no manual feature extraction, high recognition accuracy), a fault diagnosis method with improved auto-encoder incorporating attention mechanism is proposed. The method combines the superiority of convolutional neural network and attention mechanism, based on the auto-encoder structure, and adds fault classification branches, the obtained features can better express the information of the original data, which can be achieved better accuracy, generalization and robustness of fault diagnosis. In the experimental data, using the 1D time domain data of the bearing as the model input, the recognition accuracy reaches 99.68%; after adding white noise to the original data, it still has more than 97.5% accuracy; in the case of variable working conditions, it can also achieve more than 95% accuracy. The experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve fault diagnosis of bearings in complex environments and variable working conditions, and has good robustness and generalization.

articleTitle: Data-Flow Modeling of SDRAM with Bank Group in Sequential Access with Intermittent Address Jumps Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As double data rate synchronous dynamic random-access memory (DDR SDRAM) iterations continue, the hardware response rate is unable to keep up with the increase in frequency. In order to fully utilize the bus, the Bank Group mechanism has been introduced into DDR SDRAM. DDR SDRAM itself, as a random-access memory, outputs data with suspension and randomness. The introduction of Bank Group has added new uncertainties to DDR SDRAM. The original data flow model of DDR SDRAM is no longer applicable to DDR SDRAM with Bank Group. In this paper, based on the original DDR SDRAM data flow model, we propose a data flow model for DDR SDRAM with Bank Group and derives a predictive formula for suspension time in response to the access characteristics of sequential access with intermittent address jumps mode, and its effectiveness and accuracy have been experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Synchronized Joint Airborne and Ground-Based Regional Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Ground-based positioning systems have some limitations such as low vertical accuracy, blockage, and multipath effect. Compared with ground-based positioning systems, joint airborne, and ground-based positioning systems can provide better observation geometry and reduce the influence of terrain occlusion on navigation signals received by user receivers. A synchronized joint airborne and ground-based regional positioning system is proposed, which is composed of ground-based stations (GS) and airborne nodes (AN). The ANs relay the signals broadcast by GSs in the way of frequency division multiple access and synchronize the time and frequency between the ANs and GBs as well as the invisible GSs by using the relayed navigation signals, which effectively solves the signal conflict problem and the frequency drift problem of the AN. The prototype system of synchronized joint airborne and ground-based regional positioning system was built and verified by two tests. The test results of time and frequency synchronization performance based on a moving platform show that the maximum deviation of time synchronization error is 974.5 ps, and the frequency stability is 4.49e-11@1s. The comprehensive positioning test results (root mean square) show that the positioning accuracy is 2.36 m and the velocity accuracy is 0.02 m/s.

articleTitle: High-Accuracy Method for Delay Calibration of UTC(NTSC) Replicating Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The high accuracy time delay calibration of UTC(NTSC) replicating device is essentially a method to calibrate the delay of the device. Segmented calibration is used for the delay of the UTC(NTSC) replicating device. It combines relative calibration and absolute calibration, and a method of relative calibration for the delay of the device based on UTC (NTSC). Absolute calibration refers to demarcate the time delay of the antenna cable. Relative calibration refers to demarcate the time delay of the signal transmission delay and the receiver delay within the device based on UTC (NTSC). Specifically, UTC (NTSC) is used as the reference signal, and the time measurement equipment is used to measure the time bias between the PPS reproduced by UTC(NTSC) replicating device and UTC (NTSC), and the clock bias is calculated between the UTC(NTSC) replicating device and the reference equipment in the same time period. Thus, the relative delay of the UTC(NTSC) replicating device can be obtained, that is the time bias deducting the clock bias by collecting for 24-hour. By calibrating the device delay method, the timing accuracy of the UTC(NTSC) replicating device can be accurate to 0.2 ns.

articleTitle: Miniaturized High Precision Time Interval Measurement Technology Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of miniaturized time interval measurement system with high precision, high stability is designed and implemented. In the system, electronic counting method and time-to-voltage converter method are combined together to meet the requirements of the measurement range and the measurement resolution; the reference signal is used to generate calibration signals to automatically calibrate the analog circuit which is greatly affected by the temperature; the calibration data is used to correct the conversion coefficient between voltage and time interval in the software, and as a result, the effect of the temperature on the instrument reduce a lot; the double counter synchronous measurement technology working under two different frequency clocks is adopted and the logic algorithm is used to analyze and correct the measured results to avoid gross error caused by the false trigger of the counter. The whole system is realized on the FPGA. And the experiment result shows that the circuit board area of the prototype is only 10 cm2, the system's resolution is less than lOps, the measurement accuracy is better than 30ps, the measurement range is more than 20,000 seconds, and its measurement results are highly reliable.

articleTitle: Study on Automatic Positioning of Medium and Small Modular Internal and External Gears
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Machine vision rapid development of gear measurement technology, for the rapid high precision of small local visual image of gear measuring center positioning requirements, this paper proposes a mechanism of automatic positioning of internal and external gear, carrying visual detection device, based on machine vision technology, acquisition gear basic image, calculate the measured gear image, realize the non-contact detection of gear, improve the measurement efficiency and accuracy. And gives the main composition, working principle and implementation steps of automatic positioning, measuring instrument, and the ball screw, bevel gear and drive shaft structure design and strength check, finally by finite element analysis, build the key component model, force analysis verification, the results show that this method can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Application and Field Comparison of Water Quality Monitors in Unmanned Surface Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Marine ecological monitoring is becoming more and more important. Neither manual sampling nor buoy fixed-point monitoring can meet the needs of emergency monitoring. Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) have the characteristics of flexibility and low cost, and have broad application prospect in ecological monitoring. The comparison between online water quality monitoring instruments and national standard methods under static conditions has been carried out many times, but the accuracy of monitoring data during USV movement has not been studied. The National Ocean Technology Center independently developed an USV for water quality monitoring, and compared the data of self-developed water quality monitor with those of imported instruments during the movement of USV, and analyzed the correlation of the measured data of water temperature, salinity and pH value at different moving speeds. The results show that at the speed of USV less than 4 knots, the temperature, salinity and pH values of the two instruments are similar, and the data have good correlation, so they can be used as an effective supplementary means for emergency monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Vehicle Data Fusion Technology Based on Multiple Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Edge intelligence is the development trend of the integration of Ubiquitous computing and artificial intelligence, and autonomous systems represented by smart cars are playing an increasingly important role in edge intelligence architecture design, integration verification, application services, etc. This article takes the autonomous and accurate indoor mapping of intelligent vehicles as the research object, and systematically designs a boundary point generation scheme that covers exploration, filtering, publishing, and other parts. A hybrid algorithm that integrates global boundary point detection and local boundary point detection is proposed, and a hybrid path planning algorithm based on TEB is proposed for the autonomous exploration problem of intelligent vehicles. Compared to single mapping algorithms such as Gmapping, simulation experiments on the GazeBo and Stage platforms show that the proposed scheme and algorithm have higher accuracy in map fixed-point navigation and can be used as an alternative to traditional human guided autonomous mapping methods.

articleTitle: Impedance Ice Sensor Capable of Self-Componsating Temperature Drift
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to further support the development of arrayed impedance-based icing detection technology, a temperature drift self-compensation method that does not depend on traditional temperature sensors is proposed for the ice thickness measurement error problem caused by temperature variation. The method achieves compensation by establishing a mapping relationship between relaxation time and temperature to calculate the temperature of the ice layer. A theoretical model to describe the temperature drift characteristics of complex dielectric constant based on the relaxation polarization principle is established, and the ice layer temperature calculation method is proposed on the basis of complex impedance measurement. The experimental results show that the method reduces the error of ice thickness measurement, and the root mean square error reaches 0.09 mm in ice cases below 4 mm, which is clearly better than the uncompensated results.

articleTitle: Research on Four-Jaw Gripping Center-Positioning Gear Visual Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Targeting the demand for online measurement of gear intelligent manufacturing, This article proposes a new gear measurement principle and system. In order to solve the problem of measuring various parameters and accuracy of internal and external straight cylindrical gears, a new four jaw center positioning clamping mechanism, high-precision rotating platform, visual transmission module, visual acquisition system, etc., is designed. Important construction strength checks are selected to ensure measurement accuracy and speed. Through finite element analysis, key component models are constructed, Conduct effectiveness analysis and verification, and the results show that this method can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Vision Based Thread Parameter Compensation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to study the influence of thread tooth shading on the measurement accuracy of thread parameters, a compensation algorithm based on machine vision for thread tooth angle and median diameter is proposed based on the analysis of existing methods for calculating the amount of thread tooth distortion. The threaded annular groove without screw-up angle is compared with the image of the threaded plug gauge with screw-up angle to obtain the compensation amount of the thread tooth angle, and then the compensation amount of the corresponding thread tooth mid-diameter is found according to the compensation amount of the tooth angle, and finally the compensation of the thread parameters is realized. The data show that the average value of 59.999° and 18.290 mm of median diameter compensation obtained by the proposed method is close to the average value of 60.015° and 18.326 mm of median diameter measured by the contact thread gauge, and the variance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.76\times 10^{-5}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8.65\times 10^{-5}$</tex> of median diameter variance after compensation. The variance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.76\times 10^{-5}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8.65\times 10^{-4}$</tex> of the mid-diameter are smaller than the variance of the tooth angle and mid-diameter measured by the integrated measuring instrument. The results show that the compensation algorithm proposed in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Test Method of Projectile Drag Coefficient for Interior Ballistic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A test method for analyzing the projectile drag coefficient of interior ballistic based on the projectile breech pressure and the axial acceleration is proposed. This method takes advantage of an integrated onboard tester to obtain two mechanical parameters which are closely related on the timeline just through one test. After simple calculation, the drag coefficient curve of the projectile's motion in the gun bore is obtained, it provides real and effective data for improving the design and simulation of the gun bore structure.

articleTitle: Flexible PDMS Pressure Sensor Based on Mutual Inductance Coil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The increasing use of pressure sensors has spurred the pursuit of highly sensitive sensor development. This paper proposes an inductive flexible pressure sensor that employs a hollow-shell flexible PDMS sponge skeleton. Three groups of hollow-shell flexible sponge shells with varying wall thicknesses were tested. The results demonstrate that thicker walls do not promote sensor sensitivity. Among the tested sensors with wall thicknesses of 4 mm, 5 mm, and 6 mm, the sensor with a 4 mm wall thickness exhibited the highest sensitivity of approximately 42.6 Mpa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in the high pressure range of 30–100 kPa. Additionally, this sensor achieved a minimum detectable pressure of 25 Pa. Its response time was rapid, with a loading time of approximately 233 ms and an unloading time of about 117 ms. Notably, the inductive pulse output from the sensor exhibited consistent amplitude and peak patterns over 1000 applied pressure cycles, demonstrating superior immunity to interference compared to a capacitive sensor of the same size under identical conditions. Subsequent application tests revealed the accurate sensing capability of the inductive flexible pressure sensor for pulse beats, thus further confirming its feasibility for practical applications.

articleTitle: High-Speed Peak Detection Circuit for On-Chip EMI Test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 16th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the electromagnetic interference (EMI) test, the disturbance amplitude is a key parameter to be measured. It is difficult to measure the peak voltage of the disturbance on the integrated circuit (IC) because the chip is encapsulated inside a package. Existing peak detection circuits have relative long response time and thereby cannot detect high-frequency disturbance.
